title: 蚂蚁集团 InclusionAI 开源医疗大模型 LingSante-3.1：560B 的 flash 版在 HealthBench Professional 拿下 65.72 分，配套 124B 多模态版读片读报告
summary: 蚂蚁 InclusionAI 实验室发布 LingSante-3.1-flash（5600 亿参数），主打复杂医学推理和临床工作流，在 HealthBench Professional 上以 65.72 分领先，报道称超过 GPT-6 Astra 等模型；配套的 LingSante-3.1-air-VL（1240 亿参数）处理医学影像和报告，在 AFUMED-Derm、MIMIC-CXR 等评测领先。两者以 MIT 许可上架 Hugging Face，定位研究用途，医院可本地私有部署、数据不出院。看点：开源医疗模型进入可私有化落地阶段，围绕本地部署、合规和垂直工作流的服务机会变多。

title: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini：20GB 装得下、32GB Mac 或单张消费级显卡就能跑，100B 以下开源模型 Agent 编程第一
summary: Thinking Machines Lab 推出紧凑版开源权重模型 Inkling 2 Mini，体积约 20GB，可在 32GB 内存的 Mac 或单张消费级 GPU 上流畅运行；在 DeepSWE v1.1 上得分 48.2%，在 100B 参数以下的开源模型中 Agent 编程基准领先，支持 100 万 token 上下文和图像输入，Apache 2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face。社区已做出去审查版本和自定义推理引擎进一步提速，不过也有人指出与闭源前沿模型仍有差距。看点：本地私有的编程 Agent 门槛进一步降低。

t.zh-Hans: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini：20GB 装得下、32GB Mac 或单张消费级显卡就能跑，100B 以下开源模型 Agent 编程第一
t.en: Thinking Machines Publish Inkling 2 Mini: 20GB loaded, 32GB Mac or single consumption scale card to run, 100B following open source model Agent first program

s.zh-Hans: Thinking Machines Lab 推出紧凑版开源权重模型 Inkling 2 Mini，体积约 20GB，可在 32GB 内存的 Mac 或单张消费级 GPU 上流畅运行；在 DeepSWE v1.1 上得分 48.2%，在 100B 参数以下的开源模型中 Agent 编程基准领先，支持 100 万 token 上下文和图像输入，Apache 2.0 许可发布在 Hugging Face。社区已做出去审查版本和自定义推理引擎进一步提速，不过也有人指出与闭源前沿模型仍有差距。看点：本地私有的编程 Agent 门槛进一步降低。
s.en: Thinking Machines Lab introduces a compact open source weight model, Inkling 2 Mini, about 20GB, which can run on 32GB memory Mac or single consumer GPU; score 48.2% on DeepSWE v1.1, Agent programming benchmark leading in open source models below 100B parameters, supporting 1 million token context and image input, and Apache 2.0 license published on Hugging Face. Communities have made further progress in reviewing the version and the self-defined reasoning engine, although it has also been pointed out that there is still a gap with the closed-source frontier model. Point: The local private programming Agent threshold is further lowered.

title: WSJ：Databricks 洽谈以 2250 亿美元估值融资数十亿美元，比 8 月的 1900 亿美元再涨近 20%
summary: 据《华尔街日报》报道，数据与 AI 软件公司 Databricks 正就新一轮数十亿美元融资进行早期谈判，估值约 2250 亿美元，较 8 月 1900 亿美元那轮上涨近 20%。报道称其年化收入在 2026 年年中达到 70 亿美元，CEO Ali Ghodsi 以市场波动为由继续推迟 IPO。看点：私募资本让 AI 基础设施巨头可以长期不上市，企业数据 + AI 平台仍是资本最追捧的赛道之一。

t.zh-Hans: WSJ：Databricks 洽谈以 2250 亿美元估值融资数十亿美元，比 8 月的 1900 亿美元再涨近 20%
t.en: WSJ: Databricks negotiates a $225 billion valuation to finance billions of dollars, nearly 20% more than the $190 billion in August.

s.zh-Hans: 据《华尔街日报》报道，数据与 AI 软件公司 Databricks 正就新一轮数十亿美元融资进行早期谈判，估值约 2250 亿美元，较 8 月 1900 亿美元那轮上涨近 20%。报道称其年化收入在 2026 年年中达到 70 亿美元，CEO Ali Ghodsi 以市场波动为由继续推迟 IPO。看点：私募资本让 AI 基础设施巨头可以长期不上市，企业数据 + AI 平台仍是资本最追捧的赛道之一。
s.en: According to The Wall Street Journal, data and AI Software, Databricks, are negotiating an early round of multi-billion dollar financing, valued at approximately $225 billion, up by almost 20 per cent from the $190 billion round in August. It was reported that its annualized income reached $7 billion in mid-2026, and CEO Ali Ghodsi continued to delay IPO for reasons of market volatility. See: Private capital mobilization allows AI infrastructure giants to stay out of the market for a long time, and business data + AI platforms remain one of the most capital-seeking tracks.

title: Dragos 调查发现模型路由链路存在提示词窃取：OpenRouter 下架 3 家服务商、撤销 125 个端点的零数据保留标记
summary: Dragos 研究人员在 2026 年 7–11 月测试了多家模型路由和推理服务商，发现有 3 家主机在主动窃取提示词、部分转售商例行记录日志，并有 125 个 OpenRouter 端点无视零数据保留（ZDR）标记。OpenRouter 随后下架这 3 家服务商、撤销相关端点的 ZDR 状态并通知受影响客户，同时表示自身系统未被攻破。专家称这是 AI 供应链的警钟，建议转向可验证隐私（如加密执行环境），并轮换可能经由受影响链路暴露的凭证。看点：「可验证的模型调用隐私」可能成为新的采购标准和产品机会。

t.zh-Hans: Dragos 调查发现模型路由链路存在提示词窃取：OpenRouter 下架 3 家服务商、撤销 125 个端点的零数据保留标记
t.en: Dragos Survey found hint theft of model route links: OpenRouter down, 3 service providers, withdrawal of zero data retention tags for 125 ends

s.zh-Hans: Dragos 研究人员在 2026 年 7–11 月测试了多家模型路由和推理服务商，发现有 3 家主机在主动窃取提示词、部分转售商例行记录日志，并有 125 个 OpenRouter 端点无视零数据保留（ZDR）标记。OpenRouter 随后下架这 3 家服务商、撤销相关端点的 ZDR 状态并通知受影响客户，同时表示自身系统未被攻破。专家称这是 AI 供应链的警钟，建议转向可验证隐私（如加密执行环境），并轮换可能经由受影响链路暴露的凭证。看点：「可验证的模型调用隐私」可能成为新的采购标准和产品机会。
s.en: In a work done by a researcher in 2026 to 11 years, three hosts were found to have stolen the Punctuation, the Punctuation Log and the Punctuation ZDR tag for one hundred and twenty-five OpenRouter endpoints. OpenRouter then set up the three service providers, revoke the ZDR status of the relevant endpoint and notify the affected customer, while indicating that their own system was not breached. The expert referred to this as an AI supply chain alarm, suggesting a shift to verifiable privacy (e.g., encrypted execution environment) and the rotation of documents that might be exposed through the affected link. The point is that "valitable models call for privacy" may become new procurement standards and product opportunities.

title: OpenAI 首席科学家 Pachocki 发文公开历代模型 log-perplexity 数据，呼吁行业共同限制预训练直到监控工具跟上
summary: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 在 11 月 22 日的文章中公布了从 GPT-3.5（2022 年 0.99）到 GPT-6.2 Astra（0.761）以及一款未发布模型（0.732）的 log-perplexity 数据，把数值下降与对话、推理、网络安全、数学等能力突破对应起来，并警告 2027 年前可能出现能力「雪崩」，呼吁行业在监控工具完善前共同设定预训练上限。Sam Altman、Greg Brockman 表示支持，微软 AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman 承诺也会公开相关指标。看点：前沿实验室开始用统一可比的指标讨论安全阈值。

t.zh-Hans: OpenAI 首席科学家 Pachocki 发文公开历代模型 log-perplexity 数据，呼吁行业共同限制预训练直到监控工具跟上
t.en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Pachocki, published the historical model log-pertextity data and called for industry to work together to limit pre-training until surveillance tools and tools are available. Let's go.

s.zh-Hans: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 在 11 月 22 日的文章中公布了从 GPT-3.5（2022 年 0.99）到 GPT-6.2 Astra（0.761）以及一款未发布模型（0.732）的 log-perplexity 数据，把数值下降与对话、推理、网络安全、数学等能力突破对应起来，并警告 2027 年前可能出现能力「雪崩」，呼吁行业在监控工具完善前共同设定预训练上限。Sam Altman、Greg Brockman 表示支持，微软 AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman 承诺也会公开相关指标。看点：前沿实验室开始用统一可比的指标讨论安全阈值。
s.en: In an article on November 22, Jakub Pachocki, the chief scientist, OpenAI, published the log-pertext data from GPT-3.5 (0.99 in 2022) to GPT-6.2 Astra (0.761) and an unpublished model (0.732), matching the decline in values to breakthroughs in dialogue, reasoning, cybersecurity, mathematics, etc., and warned that capacity "avalanches" might occur before 2027, calling for industry to set a pre-training cap before monitoring tools are improved. Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, expressed support, and Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman promised to disclose relevant indicators. Point of view: Front-line laboratories are beginning to discuss safety thresholds using uniform and comparable indicators.

title: AI 证明广义黎曼猜想引发「超级智能」大讨论：独立方用 Claude 和 Lean 复核，Alexandr Wang 称其为人类最高智力成就
summary: 一项由 AI 完成的广义黎曼猜想（1859 年提出、关于素数分布）证明在网上持续发酵。报道称独立复核方使用 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 Lean 等工具确认了证明。Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 称这是借助一个我们并不理解的「外星心智」达成的人类智力巅峰，同时提醒控制远超人类的 AI 将面临挑战；马斯克则称欢迎奇点。看点：AI + 形式化验证（Lean）在数学上的突破会带动自动证明、验证工具和相关教育内容的关注度。

t.en: AI proves that the broad Lehman Conjecture has led to a "super-intellectual" debate: the independent party used Claude and Lean to review it, and Alexandre Wang called it the highest intellectual achievement of humanity.

s.en: A broad Lehman guess, completed by AI (1859, on the distribution of prime numbers), proves that fermentation continues online. This was confirmed by reports that independent reviewers had used tools such as Claude and Lean of Anthropic. to to to to tried to get to the point. Point of view: The breakthrough of AI + formalization (Lean) in mathematics leads to a focus on automatic certification, certification tools and related educational content.

title: Pieter Levels 公开「AI 水军回复」屏蔽名单 blockedforaireply.levels.io：约 3700 个账号，一键屏蔽并提供 JSON API
summary: 独立开发者 Pieter Levels 上线公开名单，收录约 3700 个在 X 上发重复、空洞、疑似 AI 生成回复的账号，提供一键屏蔽按钮和 JSON API，他称自己帖子下的垃圾回复已明显减少。支持者欢迎更干净的时间线，批评者（包括一些独立开发者）则抱怨误伤、缺乏证据的公开点名；申诉需公开发誓不再用 AI 回复，Levels 称复核后误判率约 0.1%。看点：「AI 垃圾内容过滤 / 信誉名单」正成为社交平台上的刚需工具方向。

t.zh-Hans: Pieter Levels 公开「AI 水军回复」屏蔽名单 blockedforaireply.levels.io：约 3700 个账号，一键屏蔽并提供 JSON API
t.en: Pieter Levels made public the "AI Water Force Response" block list blocked by blockedforfireply.leves.io: approximately 3700 accounts, one key block and provided JSON API

s.zh-Hans: 独立开发者 Pieter Levels 上线公开名单，收录约 3700 个在 X 上发重复、空洞、疑似 AI 生成回复的账号，提供一键屏蔽按钮和 JSON API，他称自己帖子下的垃圾回复已明显减少。支持者欢迎更干净的时间线，批评者（包括一些独立开发者）则抱怨误伤、缺乏证据的公开点名；申诉需公开发誓不再用 AI 回复，Levels 称复核后误判率约 0.1%。看点：「AI 垃圾内容过滤 / 信誉名单」正成为社交平台上的刚需工具方向。
s.en: The independent developer Pieter Levers has a public online list of approximately 3700 accounts that repeat, empty, suspected AI-generated responses on X, providing a one-key shield button and JSON API, which he claims has significantly reduced the amount of garbage under his post. Proponents welcomed a cleaner timeline, while critics (including some independent developers) complained of errors and lack of evidence for public naming; complaints were publicly sworn to stop using AI responses, and Levels stated that the rate of error following review was about 0.1 per cent. Read: "AI Waste Content Filter / Reliability List" is becoming the orientation of the needed tool on social platforms.

title: Pliny「词表手术」：只改「cannot」等拒答词的嵌入、不动核心权重，就让开源 Inkling 2 Mini 的拒答率大幅下降
summary: 越狱研究者 Pliny the Liberator 发布「Vocab Surgery」方法：把「cannot」等拒答 token 的嵌入向「can」等顺从 token 方向编辑，在 264 亿参数的 Inkling-2-Mini 上显著降低拒答率，而无需改动核心权重；配合「Sure, here are the detailed step-by-step instructions」这类预填短语效果更强。另有研究者发布用迭代 abliteration 得到的「Inkling-2-Mini-heretic」版本，拒答率同样骤降且能力基本保留。看点：开源本地模型的安全对齐依旧脆弱，部署方需要外置的内容安全与审计层。

t.zh-Hans: Pliny「词表手术」：只改「cannot」等拒答词的嵌入、不动核心权重，就让开源 Inkling 2 Mini 的拒答率大幅下降
t.en: Pliny "Listing" surgery: changing the embedded and core weights of rejections like "cannot" will result in a significant decrease in the refusal rate of Open Source Inkling 2 Mini

s.zh-Hans: 越狱研究者 Pliny the Liberator 发布「Vocab Surgery」方法：把「cannot」等拒答 token 的嵌入向「can」等顺从 token 方向编辑，在 264 亿参数的 Inkling-2-Mini 上显著降低拒答率，而无需改动核心权重；配合「Sure, here are the detailed step-by-step instructions」这类预填短语效果更强。另有研究者发布用迭代 abliteration 得到的「Inkling-2-Mini-heretic」版本，拒答率同样骤降且能力基本保留。看点：开源本地模型的安全对齐依旧脆弱，部署方需要外置的内容安全与审计层。
s.en: The escape researcher, Pliny the Liberator, published the Vocab Surgery method: transposing token and so on token's embedded refusals to "can" and so on, significantly lowers the rejection rate in Inkling-2-Mini on 26.4 billion parameters without changing the core weights; prefilling phrases such as "Sure, here are the deleted step-by-step integrations" are more effective. Another researcher published an iterative version of the "Inkling-2-Mini-heretic" version, with a similar sharp drop in the rate of rejection and a basic retention of capacity. Point of view: The security alignment of the open source local model remains fragile and the deploying party needs external content security and audit layers.

title: 「前线部署工程师」(FDE) 成最热 AI 岗位：招聘量一年涨 729%，美国薪资中位数 20.95 万美元
summary: 由 Palantir 带火的「前线部署工程师」（Forward-Deployed Engineer）直接驻场客户环境落地软件，兼具编码与业务理解。讨论引用的数据显示，该岗位招聘量从 2025 年 4 月到 2026 年 4 月增长 729%，美国薪资中位数约 20.95 万美元，部分公司因人手不足甚至推掉八位数订单；数据工程师因懂业务需求而尤其吃香，岗位大致是七成技术、三成沟通。看点：AI 落地的瓶颈正从模型转向交付，FDE 培训、交付外包与驻场服务都有机会。

t.zh-Hans: 「前线部署工程师」(FDE) 成最热 AI 岗位：招聘量一年涨 729%，美国薪资中位数 20.95 万美元
t.en: "FDE" into the hottest AI job: 729% annual increase in recruitment, US median salary of $2095 million

s.zh-Hans: 由 Palantir 带火的「前线部署工程师」（Forward-Deployed Engineer）直接驻场客户环境落地软件，兼具编码与业务理解。讨论引用的数据显示，该岗位招聘量从 2025 年 4 月到 2026 年 4 月增长 729%，美国薪资中位数约 20.95 万美元，部分公司因人手不足甚至推掉八位数订单；数据工程师因懂业务需求而尤其吃香，岗位大致是七成技术、三成沟通。看点：AI 落地的瓶颈正从模型转向交付，FDE 培训、交付外包与驻场服务都有机会。
s.en: Forward-Deployed Engineer, a burning Palantir-led "Front Deployment Engineer" direct-location client environment software with code and business understanding. The data cited in the discussion show that recruitment for the post increased by 729 per cent from April 2025 to April 2026, with the United States median pay of approximately $20.95 million, and that some companies have even pushed eight-digit orders out because they are understaffed; data engineers are particularly comfortable because they understand business needs, with roughly 70 per cent technology and 30 per cent communication. Point of view: AI landing bottlenecks are moving from models to delivery, and FDE training, delivery of outsourced and on-site services have opportunities.

title: 智谱 Z.ai 推出 GLM-5.4：编程和多模态视觉能力升级，GLM Coding Plan 周额度用户比 GLM-5.3 多 50% 用量
summary: Z.ai（智谱）发布 GLM-5.4，面向编程与 Agent 任务，带来更强的代码能力和多模态（视觉）能力，先向 GLM Coding Plan 用户开放，周额度用户可用量比 GLM-5.3 多 50%。Zixuan Li 宣布了此次更新，距 8 月的 GLM-5.3 不久。开发者称 UI 截图分析等功能实用，但也有人希望看到公开基准和付费计划之外的开放渠道。看点：国产编程模型订阅套餐的迭代与额度竞争仍在加速。

t.zh-Hans: 智谱 Z.ai 推出 GLM-5.4：编程和多模态视觉能力升级，GLM Coding Plan 周额度用户比 GLM-5.3 多 50% 用量
t.en: Genre Z.ai Launch GLM-5.4: Upgrading programming and multi-modular visualization, 50% more users than GLM-5.3

s.zh-Hans: Z.ai（智谱）发布 GLM-5.4，面向编程与 Agent 任务，带来更强的代码能力和多模态（视觉）能力，先向 GLM Coding Plan 用户开放，周额度用户可用量比 GLM-5.3 多 50%。Zixuan Li 宣布了此次更新，距 8 月的 GLM-5.3 不久。开发者称 UI 截图分析等功能实用，但也有人希望看到公开基准和付费计划之外的开放渠道。看点：国产编程模型订阅套餐的迭代与额度竞争仍在加速。
s.en: Z.ai (Intelligence) publishes GLM-54, which is oriented towards programming and Agent missions, bringing greater coding and multi-modular (visual) capabilities, and is initially open to GLM Coding Plan users, who are 50% more available than GLM-5.3. Zixuan Li announced the update shortly after the August GM-5.3. The developers described functional features such as UI amplification analysis as useful, but there were also those who wished to see open access outside the baseline and payment schemes. Point of view: The integrity of competition between the national production programming model subscription packages is still accelerating.

title: pequalnp.com 直播 AI Agent 群攻 P vs NP：每个证明或反例都由 Lean 即时检验，已积累数百条主张、尚无突破
summary: 11 月 22 日上线的 pequalnp.com 同时运行多个 AI Agent，有的试图证明 P=NP、有的试图否证，另有红队 Agent 专门找漏洞，所有主张都由 Lean 证明助手即时检验并形成公开记录，目前已有数百条主张但无一成功。MIT 的 Ryan Williams 概括了三种可能结局：给出不实用算法的 P=NP 证明、更难的否证，或罕见的不可判定。看点：紧随 AI 证明黎曼猜想的热度，「Agent + 形式化验证 + 公开直播」成了新的科研展示形式。

t.zh-Hans: pequalnp.com 直播 AI Agent 群攻 P vs NP：每个证明或反例都由 Lean 即时检验，已积累数百条主张、尚无突破
t.en: Péqualnp.com Live AI Agent group attack Pvs NP: Each certificate or counterfeed is tested instantaneously by Lean, with hundreds of claims accumulated and no breakthroughs

s.en: On November 22nd, the online pagenp.com runs several AIAgents, some trying to prove P=NP, others trying to deny it, and the Red Team Agent is looking for loopholes, all of which are certified by Lean's assistant for immediate testing and making public records, and hundreds of claims are currently unsuccessful. MIT's Ryan Williams sums up three possible outcomes: Give unworkable P=NP certificates, more difficult to prove, or rare undecidable. Point: Following AI's proof of the heat of Lehman's guess, "Agent + formalisation + live live" became a new form of scientific presentation.

title: 开源工具 NO SPEAKER 把 MacBook 触控板变成扬声器：用 Force Touch 震动马达发出 100Hz–4kHz 的声音
summary: 开发者 Cody Collier 开源 NO SPEAKER，利用 2015 年以后 MacBook 的 Force Touch 触觉马达振动触控板玻璃来发声，频率范围约 100 Hz 到 4 kHz；它调用 macOS 文字转语音，把音频映射为每秒最多 4000 次的马达脉冲，终端一行安装或下载 App 即可。演示里静音的笔记本也能「说唱」，已衍生出模拟机械键盘音的 MechPad 等分支，还有人设想做 MIDI 乐器。看点：硬件「另类用法」类小工具天然适合传播。

s.zh-Hans: 开发者 Cody Collier 开源 NO SPEAKER，利用 2015 年以后 MacBook 的 Force Touch 触觉马达振动触控板玻璃来发声，频率范围约 100 Hz 到 4 kHz；它调用 macOS 文字转语音，把音频映射为每秒最多 4000 次的马达脉冲，终端一行安装或下载 App 即可。演示里静音的笔记本也能「说唱」，已衍生出模拟机械键盘音的 MechPad 等分支，还有人设想做 MIDI 乐器。看点：硬件「另类用法」类小工具天然适合传播。
s.en: Developer Cody Collier Open-source NO SPEAKER, using Force Touch, MacBook, after 2015, tasting motor vibrating touch plate glass, with a frequency range of about 100 Hz to 4 kHz; it calls macOS text-to-speech, maps the audio to a maximum of 4000 motor pulses per second, installs or downloads App in one line. The silent notebooks of the demonstration can also be a rap, have derived branches like MechPad, which simulates mechanical keyboards, and have been conceived as MIDI instruments. It's natural for small tools like "other uses" of hardware to spread.

title: MemOS 联合英伟达发布 MemT-1.0-Pro：基于 Nemotron 3 Ultra，把持久记忆直接做进模型架构，已在 Hugging Face 开放
summary: MemOS 与 NVIDIA 合作推出 MemT-1.0-Pro，以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为骨干，在架构内嵌入固定大小的记忆块，模型可逐 token 读、写、更新和遗忘信息，不必依赖越来越长的上下文或外部检索工具。官方称其在同类记忆基准上领先，模型已在 Hugging Face 开放。看点：Agent 长期记忆正从「外挂 RAG / 记忆库」走向「模型原生记忆」，长期陪伴、个人助理类应用可能受益。

t.zh-Hans: MemOS 联合英伟达发布 MemT-1.0-Pro：基于 Nemotron 3 Ultra，把持久记忆直接做进模型架构，已在 Hugging Face 开放
t.en: MemOS United England release MemT-1.0-Pro: Based on Nemotron 3 Ultra, long-term memory is directly integrated into the model structure and is open in Hugging Face

s.zh-Hans: MemOS 与 NVIDIA 合作推出 MemT-1.0-Pro，以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为骨干，在架构内嵌入固定大小的记忆块，模型可逐 token 读、写、更新和遗忘信息，不必依赖越来越长的上下文或外部检索工具。官方称其在同类记忆基准上领先，模型已在 Hugging Face 开放。看点：Agent 长期记忆正从「外挂 RAG / 记忆库」走向「模型原生记忆」，长期陪伴、个人助理类应用可能受益。
s.en: MemOS works with NVIDIA to launch MemT-1.0-Pro, with Nemotron 3 Ultra as its backbone, with fixed size memory blocks embedded in the structure. Models can read, write, update and forget information on a token basis without relying on a longer context or external search tool. Officially, they are leading the same memory benchmark, and the model has been opened in Hugging Face. Point of view: Agent's long-term memory is moving from an "outside RAG / memory bank" to a "simulation of original memory" and could benefit from long-term companionship, personal assistant applications.

title: 特斯拉 FSD 15 开始推送：新增「Reality View」实时俯视 3D 视图，像一个车载实时世界模型，12 月扩大推送
summary: 特斯拉 Full Self-Driving 15 本周末开始向早期用户推送，主要是 2025 款及以后的 Model Y。新功能 Tesla Reality View 以俯视 3D 实时呈现道路、周围车辆和本车规划路径，被测试者形容为「实时世界模型」。早期反馈称跟车、避坑、泊车更顺滑自信，官方宣称在学校区域、恶劣天气等困难场景安全性提升 25 倍；也有人反映部分场景过于谨慎或有小毛病。目前仍为监督驾驶，计划 12 月扩大推送范围。看点：端到端驾驶模型开始把「世界模型」可视化给用户看。

t.zh-Hans: 特斯拉 FSD 15 开始推送：新增「Reality View」实时俯视 3D 视图，像一个车载实时世界模型，12 月扩大推送
t.en: Tesla FSD 15 Starts sending: add "Reality View" to the 3D view in real time, like a car-mounted real-time world model, and expands the delivery in December

s.zh-Hans: 特斯拉 Full Self-Driving 15 本周末开始向早期用户推送，主要是 2025 款及以后的 Model Y。新功能 Tesla Reality View 以俯视 3D 实时呈现道路、周围车辆和本车规划路径，被测试者形容为「实时世界模型」。早期反馈称跟车、避坑、泊车更顺滑自信，官方宣称在学校区域、恶劣天气等困难场景安全性提升 25 倍；也有人反映部分场景过于谨慎或有小毛病。目前仍为监督驾驶，计划 12 月扩大推送范围。看点：端到端驾驶模型开始把「世界模型」可视化给用户看。
s.en: Tesla Full Self-Driving 15 began sending it to early users this weekend, mainly Section 2025 and later Model Y. The new feature Tesla Reality View, which features 3D overlooking the road, the surrounding vehicle and the vehicle's planned path in real time, was described by the test as the "real-time world model". Early feedback stated that it was more smooth and confident with cars, pits, parking and official claims that difficult scenes, such as school areas and bad weather, were 25 times safer; it was also reflected that some of the scenes were too cautious or had minor problems. There are plans to expand the range in December to monitor driving. Point: End-to-end driving models begin to visualize the "world model" to users.

title: 马斯克：特斯拉下一代 AI5 芯片优先给 Optimus 人形机器人，汽车继续用 AI4
summary: 马斯克表示，AI4 硬件已能实现「超人级」驾驶表现，足够用于汽车；算力约为其 12 倍的 AI5 将优先用于 Optimus，应对机器人在不可预测环境中的抓取操作等更难任务，预计 2027 年 4 月前后上车（上机器人）。他称 Optimus 是特斯拉「史上最好的产品」，弗里蒙特工厂正在爬坡，明年将有可观产量；硬件成本和内存调整（如 AI4.5 内存从 32GB 降到 24GB）也影响了这次优先级安排。看点：端侧算力开始向具身智能倾斜，人形机器人成为大芯片的首要客户。

t.zh-Hans: 马斯克：特斯拉下一代 AI5 芯片优先给 Optimus 人形机器人，汽车继续用 AI4
t.en: Mask: The next generation of Tesla, A5 chips give priority to Optimus human robots, and cars continue to use AI4.

s.zh-Hans: 马斯克表示，AI4 硬件已能实现「超人级」驾驶表现，足够用于汽车；算力约为其 12 倍的 AI5 将优先用于 Optimus，应对机器人在不可预测环境中的抓取操作等更难任务，预计 2027 年 4 月前后上车（上机器人）。他称 Optimus 是特斯拉「史上最好的产品」，弗里蒙特工厂正在爬坡，明年将有可观产量；硬件成本和内存调整（如 AI4.5 内存从 32GB 降到 24GB）也影响了这次优先级安排。看点：端侧算力开始向具身智能倾斜，人形机器人成为大芯片的首要客户。
s.en: According to Mask, A4 hardware has been able to achieve "supreme" driving performance, sufficient for use in cars; A5 with approximately 12 times its calculator power will be prioritized for Optimus, responding to more difficult tasks such as robot capture in unpredictable environments, and is expected to get in the car around April 2027. He called Optimus the "best product in history" of Tesla, where the Fremont plant is climbing and will produce significant quantities next year; hardware costs and memory adjustments (e.g. AI4.5 down from 32GB to 24GB) also affected this prioritization. Point of view: End-side computing begins to tilt towards intelligence and human robots become the primary customers of large chips.

title: 印度 Sarvam AI 发布 Sarvam-105B-1711：105B 的 Flash-Lite 级新版本，指令遵循、工具调用和印度语言能力提升
summary: Sarvam AI 发布 105B 模型的新检查点 Sarvam-105B-1711，定位 Flash-Lite 档。官方称在指令遵循、对话、工具调用和印度语言的综合平均上，相比其他主流 Flash-Lite 模型达到新的性价比（帕累托）前沿；较上一版主要提升了 IFBench 指令遵循、Tau2 工具调用和自家 Indic 语言评测成绩。看点：主权 AI 路线下，本土厂商以低成本中型模型抢占多语言与 Agent 工具调用场景。

t.zh-Hans: 印度 Sarvam AI 发布 Sarvam-105B-1711：105B 的 Flash-Lite 级新版本，指令遵循、工具调用和印度语言能力提升
t.en: In India Sarvam AI publishes a new version of Sarvam-105B-1711:105B, a Flash-Lite class, command compliance, tool call and Indian Accommodation

s.zh-Hans: Sarvam AI 发布 105B 模型的新检查点 Sarvam-105B-1711，定位 Flash-Lite 档。官方称在指令遵循、对话、工具调用和印度语言的综合平均上，相比其他主流 Flash-Lite 模型达到新的性价比（帕累托）前沿；较上一版主要提升了 IFBench 指令遵循、Tau2 工具调用和自家 Indic 语言评测成绩。看点：主权 AI 路线下，本土厂商以低成本中型模型抢占多语言与 Agent 工具调用场景。
s.en: Sarvam AI releases the new checkpoint for the 105B model Sarvam-105B-1711, locates the Flash-Lite file. Officially, Flash-Lite models are at the forefront of the new value for money (Pareto) in terms of the combined average of command compliance, dialogue, tool call and Indian language; and the performance of IFBench commands, tau2 tool call and home-based Indic language assessment is mainly enhanced over the previous edition. Point: Under the sovereignty AI route, local producers use low-cost medium-sized models to gain access to multilingual and Agent tools.

title: 南非总统拉马福萨结束硅谷之行：拟设 1 亿兰特 AI 创投基金和信用担保基金，并定下 90 天落地计划
summary: 拉马福萨在硅谷访问收尾的记者会上宣布，南非拟设立 1 亿兰特的风险投资基金和信用担保基金，扶持 AI 及更广泛科技领域的初创公司；政府将对创业者的投入进行配套，并邀请私营部门共建融资生态。随行的科学家兼创业者 Siyabulela Xuza 强调要在总统提出的 90 天期限内把考察所得变成具体项目，让中小企业和创业者都能抓住 AI 机会。看点：新兴市场开始用政府配套基金 + 限期计划推动本土 AI 创业。

t.zh-Hans: 南非总统拉马福萨结束硅谷之行：拟设 1 亿兰特 AI 创投基金和信用担保基金，并定下 90 天落地计划
t.en: President Ramafosa of South Africa concluded his trip to Silicon Valley: a 100 million rand AI Foundation and Credit Guarantee Fund is proposed, and a 90-day landing plan is planned.

s.zh-Hans: 拉马福萨在硅谷访问收尾的记者会上宣布，南非拟设立 1 亿兰特的风险投资基金和信用担保基金，扶持 AI 及更广泛科技领域的初创公司；政府将对创业者的投入进行配套，并邀请私营部门共建融资生态。随行的科学家兼创业者 Siyabulela Xuza 强调要在总统提出的 90 天期限内把考察所得变成具体项目，让中小企业和创业者都能抓住 AI 机会。看点：新兴市场开始用政府配套基金 + 限期计划推动本土 AI 创业。
s.en: At the press conference that concluded the Silicon Valley visit, Ramafosa announced that South Africa intended to establish a R100 million venture capital fund and a credit guarantee fund to support start-up companies in AI and the wider field of science and technology; the Government would match the inputs of entrepreneurs and invite the private sector to co-finance the ecology. Siyabulela Xuza, a fellow scientist and entrepreneur, stressed the need to translate the findings into concrete projects within the 90-day period proposed by the President, so that both SMEs and entrepreneurs could seize AI opportunities. Note: Emerging markets are starting to promote local AI entrepreneurship with government support funds + time-bound schemes.

title: MyClaw 3.0 发布：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等任意 Agent 套进「自带工具的 AI 同事」，配 5000+ 实时数据源和最高 64 核云电脑
summary: MyClaw 推出 3.0，主打「开箱即用的 AI 同事」而不是需要人盯着的空白 Agent：可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、Pi、OpenClaw 等任意 harness 并共享上下文，内置 5000 多个实时数据源，提供最高 64 vCPU / 128GB 内存 / 1.28TB 存储的云端电脑，并可通过浏览器、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 使用，约 30 秒就绪。X 新闻相关话题称其 7 个月用户达 110 万（官方帖未直接给出该数字）。看点：Agent 赛道从「聊天助手」转向「带电脑、带工具、带数据的团队成员」。

t.zh-Hans: MyClaw 3.0 发布：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw 等任意 Agent 套进「自带工具的 AI 同事」，配 5000+ 实时数据源和最高 64 核云电脑
t.en: MyClaw 3.0 Release: insert any Agent such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw into "AI co-workers with their own tools" with 5000+ real time data sources and up to 64 nuclear cloud computers

s.zh-Hans: MyClaw 推出 3.0，主打「开箱即用的 AI 同事」而不是需要人盯着的空白 Agent：可接入 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes、Pi、OpenClaw 等任意 harness 并共享上下文，内置 5000 多个实时数据源，提供最高 64 vCPU / 128GB 内存 / 1.28TB 存储的云端电脑，并可通过浏览器、Slack、Teams、Telegram、WhatsApp 使用，约 30 秒就绪。X 新闻相关话题称其 7 个月用户达 110 万（官方帖未直接给出该数字）。看点：Agent 赛道从「聊天助手」转向「带电脑、带工具、带数据的团队成员」。
s.en: MyClaw rolls out 3.0 and calls "AI colleagues when they open the box" instead of the blanks that need to be watched, Agent: can access any naturals such as Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Pi, OpenClaw and share context, with more than 5,000 real-time data sources, with a maximum of 64 vCPU/ 128GB / 1.28TB stored cloud-end computers available in approximately 30 seconds. X News-related topics say it has 1.1 million users in seven months (the official post does not give that number directly). title: 富国银行新条款 11 月 24 日生效：用 AI Agent 操作网银「风险自负」，Agent 发起的交易一律算本人授权
summary: 富国银行更新《在线访问协议》，新增第 15 条「第三方 AI 代理」：用户用外部 AI 工具或 Agent 登录账户属于「风险自负」，Agent 发起的请求和交易都视为用户本人授权，银行不负责监控 Agent 的行为，还可以随时限制或封禁特定 AI 工具。用户要自己管理和撤销 Agent 的访问权限。富国没有像摩根大通、花旗、嘉信那样直接封禁凭证登录，而是把责任整个转给用户。摩根大通的新版数字服务协议也写明，Agent 做的一切都算用户授权，2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。WIRED 等媒体指出，Regulation E 对未授权转账的保护在 Agent 场景下被大幅架空。

Officially, it did the best in English and German in the 3-4B Activating Parameter, exceeding GPT-OSS 120B and Mistral Small 4. llama.cpp already has corresponding PR.

title: 宝洁扩大「无人值守工厂」：全球已有 15 个以上站点可整班无人运转，计划到 2030 年削减 20–30% 的生产供应链人员
summary: 宝洁（P&G）表示，「熄灯工厂」式的无人值守班次将从 2027 财年起继续扩大，预计到 2030 年制造效率最多提升 20%，生产供应链人员（含外包）减少 20%–30%。这是 2027–2030 财年最多 100 亿美元生产力节省目标的一部分。消费品巨头把自动化直接写进裁员目标，是 AI 和机器人冲击制造业就业的又一个明确信号。

t.zh-Hans: 宝洁扩大「无人值守工厂」：全球已有 15 个以上站点可整班无人运转，计划到 2030 年削减 20–30% 的生产供应链人员
t.en: Proctery expands the "unmanned factory": more than 15 sites worldwide have been left unattended, with a planned 20-30 per cent reduction in production supply chain personnel by 2030

s.zh-Hans: 宝洁（P&G）表示，「熄灯工厂」式的无人值守班次将从 2027 财年起继续扩大，预计到 2030 年制造效率最多提升 20%，生产供应链人员（含外包）减少 20%–30%。这是 2027–2030 财年最多 100 亿美元生产力节省目标的一部分。消费品巨头把自动化直接写进裁员目标，是 AI 和机器人冲击制造业就业的又一个明确信号。
s.en: According to P&G, the unmanned shift of the Lighting Plant will continue to expand from the 2027 fiscal year, with production efficiency expected to increase by up to 20 per cent by 2030 and production supply chain personnel (including outsourcing) reduced by 20-30 per cent. This is part of the top $10 billion productivity savings target for the 2027-2030 fiscal year. Consumers giants directly write about automation as a target for lay-offs is another clear signal for AI and robots to hit jobs in manufacturing.

title: Confiant 曝光 MoldyRoost 恶意广告行动：打开广告落地页就能入侵旧版 iPhone，翻备忘录和相册找加密钱包助记词
summary: 安全公司 Confiant 发现，MoldyRoost 在 5 月 12 日到 11 月 17 日间用 480 多个恶意广告域名覆盖 47 个国家，香港受害最重，其次是日本、新加坡。用户只要打开广告落地页，存在漏洞的 iOS 就会被国家级水平的漏洞链攻破，攻击者会搜索备忘录文字和相册里的二维码来找助记词，还会窃取钥匙串密码、短信和位置记录。建议尽快升级 iOS，别把助记词存在手机里。

t.zh-Hans: Confiant 曝光 MoldyRoost 恶意广告行动：打开广告落地页就能入侵旧版 iPhone，翻备忘录和相册找加密钱包助记词
t.en: Confiant exposes Moldy Roost: Opens the page of the ad to hack the old iPhone, flips the memos and albums for encryption wallets.

s.zh-Hans: 安全公司 Confiant 发现，MoldyRoost 在 5 月 12 日到 11 月 17 日间用 480 多个恶意广告域名覆盖 47 个国家，香港受害最重，其次是日本、新加坡。用户只要打开广告落地页，存在漏洞的 iOS 就会被国家级水平的漏洞链攻破，攻击者会搜索备忘录文字和相册里的二维码来找助记词，还会窃取钥匙串密码、短信和位置记录。建议尽快升级 iOS，别把助记词存在手机里。
s.en: The security company Confiant found that MuldyRoost covered 47 countries with more than 480 malicious advertising domain names between 12 May and 17 November, with Hong Kong suffering the most, followed by Japan and Singapore. As long as the user opens the page of the ad, the leaked iOS will be broken by a state-level loophole, the attackers will search for the text of the memo and the 2-D code in the album for assistive words, and will steal keyline passwords, text messages and location records. It's recommended that iOS be upgraded as soon as possible, so don't put it on the phone.

title: 英伟达董事会反转：一致决定让黄仁勋立即回任总裁、CEO 和董事，股价盘中一度大涨约 35%
summary: 11 月 23 日，英伟达宣布董事会全票通过，黄仁勋即日起回任总裁、CEO 兼董事。几天前董事会主席还公开表示不打算让他回来。官方称这一决定是在与黄仁勋多次会谈并听取美国政府高层意见后做出的。消息带动英伟达股价盘中最多涨约 35%，IREN 等 AI 基础设施股也跟着反弹。此前他因个人丑闻和相关调查辞职，参院听证等后续事项仍待观察。

t.zh-Hans: 英伟达董事会反转：一致决定让黄仁勋立即回任总裁、CEO 和董事，股价盘中一度大涨约 35%
t.en: Inverted by the British Board of Directors: the unanimous decision to return Huang In-hoon to the post of Organiser president, CEO and director was a major increase of about 35 per cent in the stock exchange.

s.zh-Hans: 11 月 23 日，英伟达宣布董事会全票通过，黄仁勋即日起回任总裁、CEO 兼董事。几天前董事会主席还公开表示不打算让他回来。官方称这一决定是在与黄仁勋多次会谈并听取美国政府高层意见后做出的。消息带动英伟达股价盘中最多涨约 35%，IREN 等 AI 基础设施股也跟着反弹。此前他因个人丑闻和相关调查辞职，参院听证等后续事项仍待观察。
s.en: On 23 November, Young Weida announced that the Board had passed its full vote and that Hoang In-hoon had returned as President and CEO. A few days ago, the Chairman of the Board publicly stated that he did not intend to have him back. Officially, this decision was taken after numerous meetings with In-hoon and after hearing the views of the United States Government. IREN and other AI infrastructure units also rebounded. He had previously resigned as a result of personal scandals and related investigations, and follow-up matters, such as the Senate hearing, remained to be observed.

title: 网络安全史上最大并购之一：CrowdStrike 以约 439 亿美元全股票收购 Zscaler，把零信任网络并入 Falcon 平台
summary: CrowdStrike 宣布全股票收购 Zscaler，每股 Zscaler 换 1.135 股 CrowdStrike，折合每股约 260.41 美元，溢价 34%，交易总值约 439 亿美元。Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry 留任负责原业务并加入董事会。双方称 AI 让网络攻击变得更快，需要把终端安全和零信任网络整合到一个平台上。交易预计在 CrowdStrike 2028 财年下半年完成，还需股东批准和监管审查。

t.zh-Hans: 网络安全史上最大并购之一：CrowdStrike 以约 439 亿美元全股票收购 Zscaler，把零信任网络并入 Falcon 平台
t.en: One of the biggest M&As in the history of cybersecurity: CrowdStrike buys about $43.9 billion in full-stock Zscaler and integrates the zero confidence network into the Falcon platform

s.zh-Hans: CrowdStrike 宣布全股票收购 Zscaler，每股 Zscaler 换 1.135 股 CrowdStrike，折合每股约 260.41 美元，溢价 34%，交易总值约 439 亿美元。Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry 留任负责原业务并加入董事会。双方称 AI 让网络攻击变得更快，需要把终端安全和零信任网络整合到一个平台上。交易预计在 CrowdStrike 2028 财年下半年完成，还需股东批准和监管审查。
s.en: CrowdStrike announced a total stock acquisition of Zscaler, 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike, equivalent to approximately US$ 260.41, a 34 per cent premium and a total trading value of approximately US$ 43.9 billion. Zscaler CEO Jay Chaudhry remained in charge of the original business and on the board of directors. Both parties claimed that AI had made cyberattacks faster, requiring the integration of terminal security and zero confidence networks into one platform. The transaction is expected to be completed in the second half of CrowdStrike 2028 and requires shareholder approval and regulatory review.

title: 深圳自变量机器人（X Square Robot）发布 WALL-OSS-1.0：基于 Qwen3.5 的原生 VLA 具身基础模型，312 个真机任务零样本成功率 55.1%
summary: 11 月 23 日，自变量机器人发布 WALL-OSS-1.0。这是一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，不针对具体任务微调也能听懂开放式指令并操作真实机器人，在 312 个真机任务上的零样本成功率为 55.1%。完整基座权重标注「即将开放」，目前先在 Hugging Face 放出 4B 的 Lite 版 RoboDojo 微调检查点，采用 Apache 2.0 协议，推理和评测代码在 GitHub 的 wall-x 仓库。

t.zh-Hans: 深圳自变量机器人（X Square Robot）发布 WALL-OSS-1.0：基于 Qwen3.5 的原生 VLA 具身基础模型，312 个真机任务零样本成功率 55.1%
t.en: Shenzhen has released WALL-OSS-1.0: Primary VLA based on Qwen3.5 Basic Body Model, 312 live mission zero success rate 55.1%

s.zh-Hans: 11 月 23 日，自变量机器人发布 WALL-OSS-1.0。这是一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型，不针对具体任务微调也能听懂开放式指令并操作真实机器人，在 312 个真机任务上的零样本成功率为 55.1%。完整基座权重标注「即将开放」，目前先在 Hugging Face 放出 4B 的 Lite 版 RoboDojo 微调检查点，采用 Apache 2.0 协议，推理和评测代码在 GitHub 的 wall-x 仓库。
s.en: On November 23rd, the VAT robot released WALL-OSS-1.0. This is a basic visual-linguistic-action (VLA) model that can understand open commands and operate real robots without task-specific fine-tuning, with a success rate of 55.1 per cent for zero samples of 312 real machine missions. Full base weight label "to be opened" is now posted at 4B Lite version of RoboDojo fine-tuning check point in Hugging Face, using the Apache 2.0 protocol, reasoning and evaluation code in the GitHub Wall-x repository.

title: 弗吉尼亚和俄勒冈两州总检察长起诉 SpaceX（X、xAI 母公司）：指 Grok 生成并传播儿童性剥削和未经同意的性化图像
summary: 弗吉尼亚州总检察长 Jay Jones 和俄勒冈州总检察长 Dan Rayfield 分别提起诉讼，被告包括 SpaceX、SpaceXAI 和 X。诉状称 Grok 的图像生成防护措施不足，导致平台上出现大量儿童性剥削内容和未经同意的深度伪造性图像，违反了州消费者保护法。这是美国州政府首次直接就生成式 AI 图像滥用起诉马斯克旗下公司，可能成为 AI 平台内容责任的标志性案件。

t.zh-Hans: 弗吉尼亚和俄勒冈两州总检察长起诉 SpaceX（X、xAI 母公司）：指 Grok 生成并传播儿童性剥削和未经同意的性化图像
t.en: Prosecution of SpaceX (X, XAI parent company) by the Attorney-General of Virginia and Oregon: means Grok generation and dissemination of images of child sexual exploitation and sexualization without consent

s.zh-Hans: 弗吉尼亚州总检察长 Jay Jones 和俄勒冈州总检察长 Dan Rayfield 分别提起诉讼，被告包括 SpaceX、SpaceXAI 和 X。诉状称 Grok 的图像生成防护措施不足，导致平台上出现大量儿童性剥削内容和未经同意的深度伪造性图像，违反了州消费者保护法。这是美国州政府首次直接就生成式 AI 图像滥用起诉马斯克旗下公司，可能成为 AI 平台内容责任的标志性案件。
s.en: The Attorney-General of Virginia, Jay Jones, and the Prosecutor-General of Oregon, Dan Rayfield, filed separate indictments against them, including SpaceX, SpaceXAI and X. The complaint stated that the lack of protection against the production of images by Grok had led to a large number of sexual exploitation of children and unconscionable, deeply false images on the platform, in violation of state consumer protection laws. This is the first time that the U.S. state government has directly prosecuted Mask's company for the misuse of generated AI images, which could be a landmark case of liability for the content of the AI platform.

title: 阿联酋上线政府 AI 管家 Mira：公民、居民和游客用一个智能体办理全部政府服务，不用再在多个平台间来回切换
summary: 迪拜酋长穆罕默德·本·拉希德在有约 1000 名官员出席的活动上发布了新的政府服务模式和 AI 管家「Mira」。Mira 是统一入口，可以跨部门理解需求、办理手续、主动提醒，目标是让人们不再需要分别登录多个政府平台。这是继此前与 OpenAI 合作打造「AI 原生政府」之后，阿联酋把 AI Agent 直接用于全民公共服务的又一步。

t.zh-Hans: 阿联酋上线政府 AI 管家 Mira：公民、居民和游客用一个智能体办理全部政府服务，不用再在多个平台间来回切换
t.en: UAE Government AI housekeeper Mira: Citizens, residents and tourists use one smart body to deliver all government services without cutting back and forth from multiple platforms Change

s.zh-Hans: 迪拜酋长穆罕默德·本·拉希德在有约 1000 名官员出席的活动上发布了新的政府服务模式和 AI 管家「Mira」。Mira 是统一入口，可以跨部门理解需求、办理手续、主动提醒，目标是让人们不再需要分别登录多个政府平台。这是继此前与 OpenAI 合作打造「AI 原生政府」之后，阿联酋把 AI Agent 直接用于全民公共服务的又一步。
s.en: Dubai Chief Mohamed Bin Rashid released a new government service model and AI housekeeper "Mira" at an event attended by about 1,000 officials. Mira is a single entry point for cross-sectoral understanding of needs, processing and proactive alerts, with the goal of eliminating the need to access multiple government platforms separately. This is a further step in the UAE's direct use of AI Agent for the public service for all, following its earlier collaboration with OpenAI to create an "AI native government".

title: Vercel AI Gateway 推出「审计版零数据保留」：只把请求路由给通过独立安全审计、证明不留存提示词的推理服务商，并做金丝雀抽检
summary: 11 月 23 日，Vercel 给 AI Gateway 加了 Audited ZDR 档位。开启后，整个团队的请求只会路由和故障转移到那些已公开独立审计报告、能证明不持久保存提示词、输出、文件、日志和缓存的推理服务商。Vercel 还会持续用「金丝雀」探针抽查服务商是否真的不留数据。此前 Dragos 用金丝雀令牌发现多家推理服务商偷存提示词、OpenRouter 随后下架服务商，「零数据保留」从一句承诺变成了需要审计证明的硬指标。

t.zh-Hans: Vercel AI Gateway 推出「审计版零数据保留」：只把请求路由给通过独立安全审计、证明不留存提示词的推理服务商，并做金丝雀抽检
t.en: Vercel AI Gateway introduces "Audit Edition Zero Data Retention": only the route of the request is Improving to reasoned service providers who pass an independent security audit and Participants certify that no hints are retained, and canary tests are performed

s.zh-Hans: 11 月 23 日，Vercel 给 AI Gateway 加了 Audited ZDR 档位。开启后，整个团队的请求只会路由和故障转移到那些已公开独立审计报告、能证明不持久保存提示词、输出、文件、日志和缓存的推理服务商。Vercel 还会持续用「金丝雀」探针抽查服务商是否真的不留数据。此前 Dragos 用金丝雀令牌发现多家推理服务商偷存提示词、OpenRouter 随后下架服务商，「零数据保留」从一句承诺变成了需要审计证明的硬指标。
s.en: On November 23rd, Vercel added AIDID ZDR to AI Gateway. Upon opening, the entire team ' s requests will be diverted only by route and failure to those reasoned service providers who have made public independent audit reports, who can prove that they do not last long enough to save their tips, outputs, documents, logs and caches. Vercel will also continue to use the canary probe to check whether the service does not leave data. Before Dragos used a canary to discover that a number of reasoned service providers had stolen hints, OpenRouter, and then a downer, Zero Data Retention, went from a promise to a hard indicator requiring audit certification.

title: 独立浏览器 Ladybird 正式进入 Alpha：从零自研引擎、不基于 Chromium/WebKit，已开放 macOS 和 Linux 下载
summary: 由 Andreas Kling 主导的开源浏览器 Ladybird 宣布进入 Alpha 阶段。macOS 用户拖进「应用程序」就能安装，Linux 推荐用 Flatpak，也有独立压缩包。Ladybird 的渲染和 JavaScript 引擎都从零写起，不依赖 Chromium、WebKit 或 Gecko，靠捐款运营、不接搜索引擎分成。它是近年少有的真正独立浏览器引擎，Alpha 版本还会有不少 bug 和功能缺失。

t.zh-Hans: 独立浏览器 Ladybird 正式进入 Alpha：从零自研引擎、不基于 Chromium/WebKit，已开放 macOS 和 Linux 下载
t.en: Independent browser Ladybird officially enters Alpha: Self-study engine from zero, not based on Chromium/WebKit, download Around MacOS and Linux

s.zh-Hans: 由 Andreas Kling 主导的开源浏览器 Ladybird 宣布进入 Alpha 阶段。macOS 用户拖进「应用程序」就能安装，Linux 推荐用 Flatpak，也有独立压缩包。Ladybird 的渲染和 JavaScript 引擎都从零写起，不依赖 Chromium、WebKit 或 Gecko，靠捐款运营、不接搜索引擎分成。它是近年少有的真正独立浏览器引擎，Alpha 版本还会有不少 bug 和功能缺失。
s.en: An open source browser led by Andreas Kling, Ladybird, announces the Alpha phase. MacOS users can be installed by dragging in "applications" and Linux is recommended for Platpak and there are independent compression packages. Ladybird's rendering and JavaScript engines have all been written from zero, without relying on Chromium, WebKit or Gecko, operating on donations and without sharing the search engine. It's a real independent browser engine in recent years, and the Alpha version will have a lot of bugs and missing functionality.

title: Marlowe 拿下 2.77 亿美元种子轮、估值 11.5 亿美元：要建「多芯片 AI 工厂」，专跑 AMD 和 Etched 等非英伟达芯片做推理
summary: Convoy 联合创始人 Dan Lewis 和前微软高管 Kutta Srinivasan 创办的 Marlowe 完成 2.77 亿美元种子轮，由 Accel 领投，估值 11.5 亿美元。公司要建设和运营针对非英伟达芯片优化的 AI 推理基础设施，先从 AMD GPU 和 Etched 的 Transformer 专用芯片做起。推理需求暴涨、英伟达供货紧张，「去英伟达化」的推理云正在吸引大额资本。

t.zh-Hans: Marlowe 拿下 2.77 亿美元种子轮、估值 11.5 亿美元：要建「多芯片 AI 工厂」，专跑 AMD 和 Etched 等非英伟达芯片做推理
t.en: Marlowe took $277 million in seed wheels, valued at $1.15 billion: to build a multichip AI factory, to run AMD and Etched and other non-engineered chips to reason.

s.zh-Hans: Convoy 联合创始人 Dan Lewis 和前微软高管 Kutta Srinivasan 创办的 Marlowe 完成 2.77 亿美元种子轮，由 Accel 领投，估值 11.5 亿美元。公司要建设和运营针对非英伟达芯片优化的 AI 推理基础设施，先从 AMD GPU 和 Etched 的 Transformer 专用芯片做起。推理需求暴涨、英伟达供货紧张，「去英伟达化」的推理云正在吸引大额资本。
s.en: Marlowe, created by Convoy co-founder Dan Lewis and former Microsoft executive Kutta Srinivasan, completed $277 million in seed wheels, with Accel leading the investment, valued at $1.15 billion. The company will build and operate an AI reasoning infrastructure for the optimization of non-British Wida chips, starting with AMD GPU and Etched's Transformer-specific chips. The reasoning cloud is attracting huge amounts of capital.

title: MachinePulse 开源 Karpo-browser 浏览器 Agent 全栈：「System 1 决策模型 + System 2 规划」双系统，宣称任务成功率 89%、成本很低
summary: MachinePulse 发布了 Karpo-browser 浏览器 Agent 框架。它把「快思考」和「慢思考」分开：大模型（System 2）负责定目标和填写内容，开源的 Karpo Decision 27B Act（System 1，基于 Qwen3.8-27B 微调的 26.1B 多模态模型）负责在页面给出的选项里，一次前向计算就选出点击、输入、滚动等动作，不用逐字生成文本，所以更快也更便宜。官方称任务成功率约 89%，权重在 Hugging Face，代码在 GitHub。

t.zh-Hans: MachinePulse 开源 Karpo-browser 浏览器 Agent 全栈：「System 1 决策模型 + System 2 规划」双系统，宣称任务成功率 89%、成本很低
t.en: MachinePulse open source Karpo-browser browser Agent complex: "System 1 Decision Model + System 2 Planning" dual system, claiming a 89% mission success rate, low cost

s.zh-Hans: MachinePulse 发布了 Karpo-browser 浏览器 Agent 框架。它把「快思考」和「慢思考」分开：大模型（System 2）负责定目标和填写内容，开源的 Karpo Decision 27B Act（System 1，基于 Qwen3.8-27B 微调的 26.1B 多模态模型）负责在页面给出的选项里，一次前向计算就选出点击、输入、滚动等动作，不用逐字生成文本，所以更快也更便宜。官方称任务成功率约 89%，权重在 Hugging Face，代码在 GitHub。
s.en: MachinePulse published the Karpo-browser Browser Agent framework. It separates "Quick Think" from "Slow Thinking": Large Model 2 is responsible for setting goals and filling in content, open source Karpo Decision 27B Act 1 (System 1, 26.1B polymodulation based on Qwen 3.8-27B finely) is responsible for selecting clicks, input, scrolls, etc., in the options given on the page, before computing, without producing text by word, so it is faster and cheaper. Officially, the mission success rate is about 89 per cent, weighting the Hugging Face, code in GitHub.

title: DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 Agent 团队 + Lean 形式化验证找量子算法：惯性约束聚变模拟的量子电路成本降到 1/10.9
summary: Google DeepMind 联合 Google Quantum AI 让 Gemini 4 Agent 团队自动搜索更高效的量子算法，每个结果都用 Lean 4 做形式化证明，确保正确。在惯性约束聚变的「阻止本领」模拟上，它们找到的电路把时空成本降到原来的 1/10.9，所需量子比特从 5650 个减到 4374 个。关键思路是把电子相互作用转到实空间网格上，并利用泡利不相容原理。这和 Lean 复核黎曼猜想证明一样，是「AI Agent + 形式化验证」做科研的又一个例子，药物分子模拟等方向也有成果。

t.zh-Hans: DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 Agent 团队 + Lean 形式化验证找量子算法：惯性约束聚变模拟的量子电路成本降到 1/10.9
t.en: DeepMind. Formatting for quantum algorithms using Gemini 4 Agent Team + Lean: the cost of a quantum circuit for inertial binding fusion simulations is reduced to 1/10.9

s.zh-Hans: Google DeepMind 联合 Google Quantum AI 让 Gemini 4 Agent 团队自动搜索更高效的量子算法，每个结果都用 Lean 4 做形式化证明，确保正确。在惯性约束聚变的「阻止本领」模拟上，它们找到的电路把时空成本降到原来的 1/10.9，所需量子比特从 5650 个减到 4374 个。关键思路是把电子相互作用转到实空间网格上，并利用泡利不相容原理。这和 Lean 复核黎曼猜想证明一样，是「AI Agent + 形式化验证」做科研的又一个例子，药物分子模拟等方向也有成果。
s.en: Google DeepMind United Google Quantum AI allows the Gemini 4Agent team to automatically search for more efficient quantum algorithms, and each result is formalized by a Lean 4 to ensure correctness. The circuits they found reduced the cost of time and space to 1/10.9 and the number of quantum bits required to 4374 from 5650 to 4374 on the IBC simulation. The key idea is to transfer electronic interactions to a real-space grid and to use the principle of impurity. This, like Lean's review of Lehman's guess, is another example of "AI Agent + Formalization" research, and there are results in the direction of drug molecule simulations.

title: OpenAI 推出 OpenWorks 试点：出钱请本地 AI 专家免费一对一辅导美国小商家，并送 3 个月 ChatGPT Business
summary: OpenAI 宣布 OpenWorks 试点项目，资助和培训一批「OpenWorks 合作伙伴」（本地 AI 专家），由他们免费给独立经营的美国小商家做一对一辅导和工作坊，帮餐馆、零售店、服务公司和制造商用 AI 拓客、投广告、搭建小工具。参与的商家还能免费使用 3 个月 ChatGPT Business。软件/SaaS 公司以及有风投或私募股权背景的企业不在范围内。项目目前覆盖 20 个社区。这相当于 OpenAI 直接下场做「AI 落地服务」，也说明面向中小商家的 AI 陪跑和咨询是真实需求。

t.zh-Hans: OpenAI 推出 OpenWorks 试点：出钱请本地 AI 专家免费一对一辅导美国小商家，并送 3 个月 ChatGPT Business
t.en: OpenAI Launch OpenWorks Pilot: Ask local AI experts for free one-on-one tutoring of small businesses in the United States for three months

s.zh-Hans: OpenAI 宣布 OpenWorks 试点项目，资助和培训一批「OpenWorks 合作伙伴」（本地 AI 专家），由他们免费给独立经营的美国小商家做一对一辅导和工作坊，帮餐馆、零售店、服务公司和制造商用 AI 拓客、投广告、搭建小工具。参与的商家还能免费使用 3 个月 ChatGPT Business。软件/SaaS 公司以及有风投或私募股权背景的企业不在范围内。项目目前覆盖 20 个社区。这相当于 OpenAI 直接下场做「AI 落地服务」，也说明面向中小商家的 AI 陪跑和咨询是真实需求。
s.en: OpenAi announced the OpenWorks pilot project to finance and train a group of OpenWorks Partners (local AI experts) who provide one-on-one counselling and workshops free of charge to small, self-employed businesses in the United States, helping restaurants, retail stores, service companies and manufacturers with the use of AAI explorers, advertising and small tools. The participating merchants are also free of charge for three months, ChatGPT Business. Software/SaaS and enterprises with a background in investment or private equity are excluded. The project currently covers 20 communities. This is equivalent to OpenAI's going straight to "AI landing service" and explains the real need for AI accompanying and counselling for small and medium-sized businesses.

title: Kagi Mail 公测：付费搜索引擎 Kagi 推出隐私邮箱和日历，无广告、不扫描邮件，支持自定义域名和无限别名
summary: 11 月 23 日，Kagi 开放 Kagi Mail 公测，提供 @kagimail.com 地址，也可以绑定自己的域名。服务包含 50 GB 存储、无限别名和域名、日历和可选的 AI 功能，主打不靠广告、不拿邮件训练模型。Kagi Ultimate 会员免费使用，其他用户免费试用 60 天后每年 99 美元。这是继付费搜索之后，Kagi 用「付费换隐私」挑战 Gmail，在 Hacker News 上讨论很热。

t.zh-Hans: Kagi Mail 公测：付费搜索引擎 Kagi 推出隐私邮箱和日历，无广告、不扫描邮件，支持自定义域名和无限别名
t.en: Kagi Mail Public Survey: Pay Search Engine Kagi Launches Private Mailboxes and Calendars, No Advertising, No Scanning of Mail, Supporting Custom Domains and Unlimited Names

s.zh-Hans: 11 月 23 日，Kagi 开放 Kagi Mail 公测，提供 @kagimail.com 地址，也可以绑定自己的域名。服务包含 50 GB 存储、无限别名和域名、日历和可选的 AI 功能，主打不靠广告、不拿邮件训练模型。Kagi Ultimate 会员免费使用，其他用户免费试用 60 天后每年 99 美元。这是继付费搜索之后，Kagi 用「付费换隐私」挑战 Gmail，在 Hacker News 上讨论很热。
s.en: On November 23, Kagi opened the Kagi Mail survey to provide @kagimail.com addresses and can also bind its domain name. The service contains 50 GB storage, unlimited aliases and domain names, calendars and optional AI functions, which do not rely on advertising and do not use a mail training model. The Kagi Ultimate membership is free of charge, while the rest of the users are free of charge for trial purposes of $99 per year after 60 days. This is a challenge for Kagi to use "pay for privacy" after the fee search, and it's a hot discussion on Hacker News.

title: 开源项目 XNU Linux：把苹果 XNU 内核做成 Linux 内核模块，不用虚拟机就能在 arm64 Linux 上跑完整的 macOS 图形界面
summary: GitHub 项目 AFK-surf/xnulinux 把苹果开源的 XNU 内核编译成 Linux 可加载模块（xnu.ko），再用 fki.ko 把内存、计时器、文件、网络和 GPU 访问转接给 Linux。这样不靠虚拟机，就能把 macOS 27 系统盘一路启动到登录窗口、WindowServer、Dock、访达，并运行 Safari 和 Chrome。目前需要支持 PAC 和 4K 页的 arm64 Linux 主机，以及用户自备的 macOS 磁盘镜像。项目在 HN 上获得 500 多分，Phoronix 也做了报道。

t.zh-Hans: 开源项目 XNU Linux：把苹果 XNU 内核做成 Linux 内核模块，不用虚拟机就能在 arm64 Linux 上跑完整的 macOS 图形界面
t.en: Open-source project XNU Linux: make the apple XNU kernel into the Linux kernel module, without a virtual machine to run the full macOS graphics field on the arm64 Linux Noodles.

s.zh-Hans: GitHub 项目 AFK-surf/xnulinux 把苹果开源的 XNU 内核编译成 Linux 可加载模块（xnu.ko），再用 fki.ko 把内存、计时器、文件、网络和 GPU 访问转接给 Linux。这样不靠虚拟机，就能把 macOS 27 系统盘一路启动到登录窗口、WindowServer、Dock、访达，并运行 Safari 和 Chrome。目前需要支持 PAC 和 4K 页的 arm64 Linux 主机，以及用户自备的 macOS 磁盘镜像。项目在 HN 上获得 500 多分，Phoronix 也做了报道。
s.en: The GitHub project AFK-surf/xnulinux translates the XNU core of apple open source into Linux Loadable Module (xnu.ko) and transfers memory, timers, files, network and GPU access to Linux with fki.ko. This way, instead of a virtual machine, the MacOS 27 system drives all the way to the login window, WindowsServer, Dock, Visita and runs Safari and Chrome. There is currently a need to support the arm64 Linux host on PAC and 4K pages, as well as the macOS disk image that the user has prepared. The project received more than 500 points on HN and Phoronix also reported.

title: a16z 领投 1.1 亿美元种子轮：Dreamer 作者 Danijar Hafner 创办 Embo，用「世界模型」给机器人造大脑
summary: 旧金山新公司 Embo 完成 1.1 亿美元种子轮，由 Andreessen Horowitz 领投。创始人 Danijar Hafner 是 Dreamer 系列世界模型智能体的作者。Embo 认为世界模型是下一代前沿 AI：先用互联网规模的视频和机器人数据预训练，让机器人能预判动作后果、从失误中恢复，并在陌生环境里稳定干活，而不是只在演示里叠衣服、做饭。

t.zh-Hans: a16z 领投 1.1 亿美元种子轮：Dreamer 作者 Danijar Hafner 创办 Embo，用「世界模型」给机器人造大脑
t.en: a16z takes the $110 million seed wheel: Dreamer by Danijar Hafner created Embo to make the brain of a robot using a "world model"

s.zh-Hans: 旧金山新公司 Embo 完成 1.1 亿美元种子轮，由 Andreessen Horowitz 领投。创始人 Danijar Hafner 是 Dreamer 系列世界模型智能体的作者。Embo 认为世界模型是下一代前沿 AI：先用互联网规模的视频和机器人数据预训练，让机器人能预判动作后果、从失误中恢复，并在陌生环境里稳定干活，而不是只在演示里叠衣服、做饭。
s.en: The new San Francisco company Embo finished the $110 million seed wheel, which was led by Andressen Horowitz. The founder, Danijar Hafner, is the author of the Dreamer series of world models. Embo sees the world model as the next-generation frontier AI: training with Internet-scale video and robotic data to enable robots to predict the consequences of action, recover from mistakes and work steadily in strange environments rather than simply folding clothes and cooking in demonstrations.

title: Signal 默认开启「屏蔽 Siri AI」：iOS 27 上禁止截屏和录屏，防止手机自带 AI 助手读取聊天内容
summary: Signal 8.37 起在 iOS 27 上默认开启「Block Siri AI」，阻止截屏、录屏和 Siri AI 读取屏幕，用户可在 设置 > 隐私 里关闭或暂停 10 分钟；Android 版 8.35.1 起，在 Gemini 等 AI 助手试图读取屏幕时会自动开启屏幕安全。Signal 表示，系统级 AI 助手越来越多默认就能看屏幕，所以改为默认防护。Mac 版暂不支持。

t.zh-Hans: Signal 默认开启「屏蔽 Siri AI」：iOS 27 上禁止截屏和录屏，防止手机自带 AI 助手读取聊天内容
t.en: Signal default to open "Siri AI": iOS 27 to block screens and videotapes and to prevent cell phones from taking AI assistants to read chats

s.zh-Hans: Signal 8.37 起在 iOS 27 上默认开启「Block Siri AI」，阻止截屏、录屏和 Siri AI 读取屏幕，用户可在 设置 > 隐私 里关闭或暂停 10 分钟；Android 版 8.35.1 起，在 Gemini 等 AI 助手试图读取屏幕时会自动开启屏幕安全。Signal 表示，系统级 AI 助手越来越多默认就能看屏幕，所以改为默认防护。Mac 版暂不支持。
s.en: Signal 8.37 Starts with the default "Block Siri AI" on iOS 27 to prevent the blocking, recording and siri AI reading screens from being closed or suspended for 10 minutes in setting > privacy; Android 8.35.1 starts, and automatically opens screen security when Gemini and other AI assistants try to read the screens. Signal indicates that the system-level AI assistant is increasingly able to view the screen by default, so the default shield is changed. The Mac version is not supported.

title: 马斯克向数百名工程师承认 SpaceX 在 AI 上落后对手，转而优先把算力租给 Anthropic 和谷歌赚钱，并砍掉多个 AI 项目
summary: 据报道，马斯克向 SpaceX 数百名工程师展示数据，承认公司 AI 能力落后于竞争对手，决定优先出租 GPU 算力换收入，并削减了几个 AI 项目。Anthropic 是最大租户：12 月全部合同算力到位后，每月约付 31 亿美元，合同至 2029 年总额最高 1205 亿美元；谷歌也在付费租用。外界认为这让马斯克陷入两难：对手正变成他最大的客户。

t.zh-Hans: 马斯克向数百名工程师承认 SpaceX 在 AI 上落后对手，转而优先把算力租给 Anthropic 和谷歌赚钱，并砍掉多个 AI 项目
t.en: Mask admits to hundreds of engineers that SpaceX is lagging behind on AI, and prefers to rent credit to Anthropic and Google for money and cut down several AI projects.

s.zh-Hans: 据报道，马斯克向 SpaceX 数百名工程师展示数据，承认公司 AI 能力落后于竞争对手，决定优先出租 GPU 算力换收入，并削减了几个 AI 项目。Anthropic 是最大租户：12 月全部合同算力到位后，每月约付 31 亿美元，合同至 2029 年总额最高 1205 亿美元；谷歌也在付费租用。外界认为这让马斯克陷入两难：对手正变成他最大的客户。
s.en: It was reported that Mask showed data to hundreds of SpaceX engineers, admitted that the company ' s AI capacity was behind that of its competitors, decided to give priority to the rental of GPUs for revenue and reduced several AI projects. Anthropic is the largest tenant: when the full contract is in place in December, approximately $3.1 billion is paid per month, up to a total of $12.5 billion in 2029; Google is also paying rents. This is seen as a dilemma for Mask: the opponent is becoming his biggest client.

title: Nothing 揭晓首款 AI 设备 Ear (note)：耳机录通话、充电盒麦克风录线下会议，App 自动转写和总结，12 月 8 日发布
summary: Nothing 公布此前预告的 AI 原生新品：Ear (note) 耳机。耳机本身可录电话，充电盒上的麦克风能录面对面会议，按 Talk 键开始录音；配套 App 提供转写、摘要，并可与 AI Agent 交互。12 月 8 日发布，价格未公布。这是 Carl Pei 所说「不是新屏幕、不是 App」的 AI 硬件路线，直接对标 Plaud 等 AI 录音笔。

t.zh-Hans: Nothing 揭晓首款 AI 设备 Ear (note)：耳机录通话、充电盒麦克风录线下会议，App 自动转写和总结，12 月 8 日发布
t.en: Nothing 345 AI Device Ear (note): Headphone call, charge box microphone-recording session, App auto-translation and summary, released on 8 December

s.zh-Hans: Nothing 公布此前预告的 AI 原生新品：Ear (note) 耳机。耳机本身可录电话，充电盒上的麦克风能录面对面会议，按 Talk 键开始录音；配套 App 提供转写、摘要，并可与 AI Agent 交互。12 月 8 日发布，价格未公布。这是 Carl Pei 所说「不是新屏幕、不是 App」的 AI 硬件路线，直接对标 Plaud 等 AI 录音笔。
s.en: Nothing to publish an AI (note) headphone that was premonitioned earlier. The headphone itself can record telephones, the microphones on the charger can record face-to-face meetings and start recording by pressing the Talk key; the app provides transliteration, summary and interaction with AI Agent. Issued 8 December, price unpublished. This is what Carl Pei says about "not new screens, not App" of the AI hardware route, which directly corresponds to the marked Plaud and so on.

title: 开源笔记 App FSNotes 上架 9 年后被苹果从全部欧洲 App Store 下架：开发者两次工单均无回复，HN 热议
summary: 乌克兰独立开发者 glushchenko 发文称，开源 macOS/iOS 笔记应用 FSNotes 被苹果从所有欧洲区 App Store 下架，起因是 10 月销售款未到账。他已在 App Store Connect 补齐欧盟《数字服务法》（DSA）要求的交易商合规信息，并提交乌克兰政府的个体户登记文件，但 11 月 5 日和 17 日开的两个支持工单至今无人回复。帖子登上 Hacker News，引发对苹果审核和 DSA 合规流程的讨论。

t.zh-Hans: 开源笔记 App FSNotes 上架 9 年后被苹果从全部欧洲 App Store 下架：开发者两次工单均无回复，HN 热议
t.en: Open Source Notes App FSNotes Upboard 9 Years Later Apple Down From All Europe App Store: Developer Unrecovered Two Worksheets, HN Hot

s.zh-Hans: 乌克兰独立开发者 glushchenko 发文称，开源 macOS/iOS 笔记应用 FSNotes 被苹果从所有欧洲区 App Store 下架，起因是 10 月销售款未到账。他已在 App Store Connect 补齐欧盟《数字服务法》（DSA）要求的交易商合规信息，并提交乌克兰政府的个体户登记文件，但 11 月 5 日和 17 日开的两个支持工单至今无人回复。帖子登上 Hacker News，引发对苹果审核和 DSA 合规流程的讨论。
s.en: The Ukrainian independent developer Glushchenko wrote that the open source MacOS/iOS notes application FSNotes was mounted by apples from App Store in all European regions because of the non-payment of sales in October. He has completed the compliance information required by the European Union Digital Services Act (DSA) and submitted to the Government of Ukraine an individual registration document, but has not yet received a response to the two support work orders opened on 5 and 17 November. Postboarding Hacker News, triggering discussion on Apple Audit and DSA Compliance Process.

title: Vercel 推出实验性 Board：给人和编程 Agent 共用的留言板，频道、帖子、可认领任务全在命令行里完成
summary: Vercel 发布 Board（实验版），是团队成员和编程 Agent 共用的消息板：有频道、帖子线程、标签和任务队列。Agent 可以用 vercel board 命令发帖、@队友、阻塞等待被提及，或从队列里认领任务并回报进度，人可以在同一线程里跟进和回复；还支持按频道授权读、发帖、管理等权限。所有套餐可用，实验期免费，官方还给了用 Board 搭 Agent 集群的指南。

t.zh-Hans: Vercel 推出实验性 Board：给人和编程 Agent 共用的留言板，频道、帖子、可认领任务全在命令行里完成
t.en: Vercel rolls out experimental Board: a message board shared with Agent. Channels, posts, searchable tasks are done in the command line.

s.zh-Hans: Vercel 发布 Board（实验版），是团队成员和编程 Agent 共用的消息板：有频道、帖子线程、标签和任务队列。Agent 可以用 vercel board 命令发帖、@队友、阻塞等待被提及，或从队列里认领任务并回报进度，人可以在同一线程里跟进和回复；还支持按频道授权读、发帖、管理等权限。所有套餐可用，实验期免费，官方还给了用 Board 搭 Agent 集群的指南。
s.en: Vercel publishes Board (experimental version), a message board shared by team members and programming Agent: Channels, tabs, tags and task queues. Agent can use a vercel board command to post, @teammate, block to wait to be mentioned, or take the task from the queue and return progress, and can follow up and respond in the same line; it also supports channel-authorized read, post, manage, etc. All packages are available, experimental periods are free “3. Official guidance was also given to Board for the Agent cluster.

title: Kit Langton 发布 macOS 平铺窗口管理器 Spaceman：专为 Apple 芯片打造，窗口并排不重叠、支持 10 个编号工作区，免费预览
summary: 开发者 Kit Langton（opencode 团队）推出 Spaceman，一个面向 Apple 芯片 Mac（macOS 14 以上）的平铺式窗口管理器：自动把窗口并排铺开、互不遮挡，支持 10 个编号工作区和键盘快捷操作，目前免费预览。发布推文短时间内获得数千浏览，是 Rectangle、AeroSpace 之外的新选择。

t.zh-Hans: Kit Langton 发布 macOS 平铺窗口管理器 Spaceman：专为 Apple 芯片打造，窗口并排不重叠、支持 10 个编号工作区，免费预览
t.en: Kit Langton Publishs MacOS Tilt Window Manager Spaceman: Create Adopted for Apple Chips without overlapping windows, supporting 10 numbered workspaces, free preview

s.zh-Hans: 开发者 Kit Langton（opencode 团队）推出 Spaceman，一个面向 Apple 芯片 Mac（macOS 14 以上）的平铺式窗口管理器：自动把窗口并排铺开、互不遮挡，支持 10 个编号工作区和键盘快捷操作，目前免费预览。发布推文短时间内获得数千浏览，是 Rectangle、AeroSpace 之外的新选择。
s.en: The developer Kit Langton (opencode team) launched Spaceman, a smooth window manager for Apple chip Mac (macOS 14 and above): automatically side-drive windows, unshielded, supports 10 numbered workspaces and keyboard shortcuts, and is currently providing free previews. A few thousand viewers have been given in short notice.

title: OpenAI 把 GPT-6.2 Sol 放进 ChatGPT 聊天页：Plus、Pro、企业版陆续上线，擅长复杂指令、联网比价和看图
summary: OpenAI 11 月 23 日开始在全球逐步推送专为 ChatGPT 聊天页优化的 GPT-6.2（Sol）版本，覆盖 Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户（企业版需管理员开启）。官方说它更会处理带详细要求的复杂请求和联网查资料，比如比较周末酒店时权衡价格和位置并给出推荐；读图和比价能力也有提升。

t.zh-Hans: OpenAI 把 GPT-6.2 Sol 放进 ChatGPT 聊天页：Plus、Pro、企业版陆续上线，擅长复杂指令、联网比价和看图
t.en: OpenAI puts GPT-6.2 Sol in ChatGPT chat pages Rapids, Pro, Enterprise on line, good at complex commands, network pricing and graphics

s.zh-Hans: OpenAI 11 月 23 日开始在全球逐步推送专为 ChatGPT 聊天页优化的 GPT-6.2（Sol）版本，覆盖 Plus、Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 用户（企业版需管理员开启）。官方说它更会处理带详细要求的复杂请求和联网查资料，比如比较周末酒店时权衡价格和位置并给出推荐；读图和比价能力也有提升。
s.en: On November 23, OpenAI began a gradual global roll-out of a GPS-6.2 (Sol) version of the ChatGPT chat page, which covers the users of Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise (the business version needs to be opened). Officially, it is more capable of processing complex requests with detailed requirements and web-based information, such as weighing prices and locations and making recommendations when comparing weekend hotels; and improving readable and competitive abilities.

title: Arm 律师函逼停热门 AArch64 指令速查站「Jon's Arm Reference」：12 月 4 日关站，HN 近 300 分热议
summary: 开发者 Jon Palmisc 维护多年的 arm.jonpalmisc.com，提供 Armv8-A / Armv9-A 的 AArch64 指令集和系统寄存器可搜索参考，是很多底层和逆向开发者的常用书签。站长在首页公告：Arm 的律师通知他下架网站，否则将采取法律行动，网站将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日停止服务，他会想办法让旧链接继续可用。消息登上 Hacker News 首页，开发者普遍批评 Arm 官方文档难用却打压社区替代品。

t.zh-Hans: Arm 律师函逼停热门 AArch64 指令速查站「Jon's Arm Reference」：12 月 4 日关站，HN 近 300 分热议
t.en: Arm's lawyer's letter shuts down the hot door Aarch64.

s.zh-Hans: 开发者 Jon Palmisc 维护多年的 arm.jonpalmisc.com，提供 Armv8-A / Armv9-A 的 AArch64 指令集和系统寄存器可搜索参考，是很多底层和逆向开发者的常用书签。站长在首页公告：Arm 的律师通知他下架网站，否则将采取法律行动，网站将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日停止服务，他会想办法让旧链接继续可用。消息登上 Hacker News 首页，开发者普遍批评 Arm 官方文档难用却打压社区替代品。
s.en: The developer Jon Palmisc maintains arm.jonpalmisc.com for many years, providing the Armv8-A/Armv9-A Aarch64 command set and system repository searchable for reference, which is a common bookmark for many bottom and reverse developers. On the front page, the station director announced that Arm's lawyer had informed him that he was going to go down on the website, otherwise legal action would be taken and that the site would be discontinued on 4 December 2026, and he would find a way to keep the old link available. The news appeared on the home page of Hacker News, where developers generally criticized Arm’s hard-to-use official documents but pressured community alternatives.

title: Vercel CEO Rauch 晒「个人评测」：让 Agent 分析自己全部编程会话，结论选 Gemini 4 Neon 而非 Claude Opus 5.5
summary: Guillermo Rauch 让 Fable 复盘他在 fx.sh 编程 Agent 上的全部会话，比较 Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Neon 哪个更适合自己。他晒出的数据显示：Neon 需要用户纠正的比例 1.0%（Opus 3.2%），被中途取消的比例 1.4%（Opus 9.3%），但 Opus 单轮更快。Rauch 称谷歌「全面回归」却被严重低估，帖子引发开发者用自己的会话日志做「个人评测」的讨论。这只是他个人场景的结论，不是公开基准。

t.zh-Hans: Vercel CEO Rauch 晒「个人评测」：让 Agent 分析自己全部编程会话，结论选 Gemini 4 Neon 而非 Claude Opus 5.5
t.en: Vercel CEO Rauch: Allow Agent to analyze all his programming sessions and conclude with Gemini 4 Neon instead of Claude Opus 5.5

s.zh-Hans: Guillermo Rauch 让 Fable 复盘他在 fx.sh 编程 Agent 上的全部会话，比较 Claude Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Neon 哪个更适合自己。他晒出的数据显示：Neon 需要用户纠正的比例 1.0%（Opus 3.2%），被中途取消的比例 1.4%（Opus 9.3%），但 Opus 单轮更快。Rauch 称谷歌「全面回归」却被严重低估，帖子引发开发者用自己的会话日志做「个人评测」的讨论。这只是他个人场景的结论，不是公开基准。
s.en: Guillermo Rauch let Fable reset all his conversations on fx.sh programming Agent, comparing Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Neon to which he is better suited. The data he tanned showed that the percentage of Neuon who needed a user correction was 1.0 per cent (Opus 3.2 per cent) and 1.4 per cent (Opus 9.3 per cent), but that the single round was faster. Rauch’s claim that Google’s “comprehensive return” was seriously underestimated and the post prompted the developers to use their conversation logs to make a “personal assessment”. This is the conclusion of his personal scene, not an open benchmark.

title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 测试版：AI 审 PR、修失败检查和合并冲突，还能按团队规则自动批准常规改动
summary: Claude Ship 是一组面向 GitHub 拉取请求的 Agent，目前对 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 用户开放测试：Code Review 查逻辑错误、安全漏洞和边界情况；PR Steward 自动修复失败的 CI 检查、合并冲突和评审意见；Claude Approvals 按仓库里的 .claude/approvals.yml 策略批准常规改动，或要求人工签字，可先观察模式再设为必过检查。The Verge、The New Stack 均有报道，「AI 自己批准 PR」引发争议。

t.zh-Hans: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship 测试版：AI 审 PR、修失败检查和合并冲突，还能按团队规则自动批准常规改动
t.en: Anthropic rolls out Claude Ship test version: AI review PR, repair failure check and merge conflicts, and automatically approves general changes according to team rules

s.zh-Hans: Claude Ship 是一组面向 GitHub 拉取请求的 Agent，目前对 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 用户开放测试：Code Review 查逻辑错误、安全漏洞和边界情况；PR Steward 自动修复失败的 CI 检查、合并冲突和评审意见；Claude Approvals 按仓库里的 .claude/approvals.yml 策略批准常规改动，或要求人工签字，可先观察模式再设为必过检查。The Verge、The New Stack 均有报道，「AI 自己批准 PR」引发争议。
s.en: Claude Ship, a group of Agents who have requested to pull GitHub, currently has open-ended tests for Claude Team and Enterprise users: Code Review to check logical errors, security loopholes and boundaries; PR Stewart to automatically repair failed CI checks, merge conflicts and evaluate opinions; Claude Approvals to approve conventional changes by the .claude/approvals.yml policy in the warehouse, or to require a manual signature, which can be made mandatory by observing the mode. The Verge and The New Stack have all reported that "AI's approval of PR" has been controversial.

title: Atlassian 公开 AI 研发实验教训：十来个团队打破岗位边界、几周清空积压，一个月后却失速——方向比速度更重要
summary: Atlassian 让约 10 个团队的工程师、产品经理和设计师都用 AI 直接写代码上线、不分角色，起初几周就清空了积压需求；但一个月后势头消退，因为人人都在「划船」，没人定方向、做关键取舍。之后产品和设计回到掌舵位置：排优先级、补充客户背景、把关质量。Atlassian 发布了 3 条经验和一份 AI 产品研发流程（AI PDLC）手册。

t.zh-Hans: Atlassian 公开 AI 研发实验教训：十来个团队打破岗位边界、几周清空积压，一个月后却失速——方向比速度更重要
t.en: Atlassian Open AI Research and Development Experiment Lessons: A dozen teams broke the job boundary, cleared the backlog for weeks, and one month later, the speed was more important than the speed.

s.zh-Hans: Atlassian 让约 10 个团队的工程师、产品经理和设计师都用 AI 直接写代码上线、不分角色，起初几周就清空了积压需求；但一个月后势头消退，因为人人都在「划船」，没人定方向、做关键取舍。之后产品和设计回到掌舵位置：排优先级、补充客户背景、把关质量。Atlassian 发布了 3 条经验和一份 AI 产品研发流程（AI PDLC）手册。
s.en: Atlassian allowed engineers, product managers and designers from about 10 teams to use AI directly to write online, without any role, and to clear the backlog of needs in the first few weeks; but a month later, the momentum faded, as everyone was " rowing" and no one was taking the key choices. The product and design then returned to the steering position: ranking, supplementing the client background, clearance quality. Atlassian has published 3 experiences and an AI product development process (AI PDF) manual.

title: 实测 25 款 AI 购物助手、200 次真实下单只成功 28 次：成功率 14%，没有一款全部完成
summary: Assistant Benchmark 让 25 个 AI 助手各完成 8 个真实购物任务，共 200 次下单尝试，覆盖 Nike、Amazon、Target 等商店，最终只有 28 单被商家接受，成功率 14%。失败原因：付款前被网站拦截占 36%，助手自身出错占 27.5%，未完成占 12%，付款被拒占 6.5%，被取消或退款占 4%。在银行把 Agent 操作风险转嫁给用户、沃尔玛等开放 Agent 接口的同时，「代理电商」离真正可用还很远。

t.zh-Hans: 实测 25 款 AI 购物助手、200 次真实下单只成功 28 次：成功率 14%，没有一款全部完成
t.en: Section 25 AI Shopping Assistant, 200 real listings only worked 28 times: 14% success rate, not all of them.

s.zh-Hans: Assistant Benchmark 让 25 个 AI 助手各完成 8 个真实购物任务，共 200 次下单尝试，覆盖 Nike、Amazon、Target 等商店，最终只有 28 单被商家接受，成功率 14%。失败原因：付款前被网站拦截占 36%，助手自身出错占 27.5%，未完成占 12%，付款被拒占 6.5%，被取消或退款占 4%。在银行把 Agent 操作风险转嫁给用户、沃尔玛等开放 Agent 接口的同时，「代理电商」离真正可用还很远。
s.en: Assistant Benchmark allowed 25 AI assistants to perform eight real shopping missions each, 200 single attempts to cover shops like Nike, Amazon, Target, and ultimately only 28 businesses, with a 14% success rate. Reasons for failure: 36 per cent before payment was intercepted by the website, 27.5 per cent by the assistant himself, 12 per cent by failure, 6.5 per cent by refusal and 4 per cent by cancellation or refund. While banks transfer the risk of Agent operations to users, Wal-Mart and others open Agent interfaces, "agents" are far from actually available.

title: YC F26 公司 Perit 4.5 个月营收超 1100 万美元：雇客服、店主等真实从业者录语音和第一视角视频，卖给前沿 AI 实验室
summary: Perit 招募各行业专家，在真实家庭和工作场所用胸戴或头戴相机录制第一视角视频，并采集语音、代码和多模态数据，覆盖 9 种语言，再交给从业者打分，卖给前沿 AI 实验室做训练和强化学习环境。公司称成立 4.5 个月营收已超 1100 万美元，还上线了 Perit Marketplace：个人可提交自有数据或搭建 RL 任务，由 Perit 对接实验室并分成。

t.zh-Hans: YC F26 公司 Perit 4.5 个月营收超 1100 万美元：雇客服、店主等真实从业者录语音和第一视角视频，卖给前沿 AI 实验室
t.en: YC F26 Perit 4.5 over $11 million per month: real practitioners, such as customers, shopkeepers, recorded voice and first-view videos, sold to Frontline AI Laboratories

s.zh-Hans: Perit 招募各行业专家，在真实家庭和工作场所用胸戴或头戴相机录制第一视角视频，并采集语音、代码和多模态数据，覆盖 9 种语言，再交给从业者打分，卖给前沿 AI 实验室做训练和强化学习环境。公司称成立 4.5 个月营收已超 1100 万美元，还上线了 Perit Marketplace：个人可提交自有数据或搭建 RL 任务，由 Perit 对接实验室并分成。
s.en: Perit recruits specialists from various professions to record first-view videos with a chest or head camera in real homes and workplaces, and collects voice, code and multi-mode data covering nine languages, which are then rated by practitioners and sold to the Frontline AI Laboratory for training and enhanced learning environments. The company stated that it had received more than $11 million for 4.5 months and that it was also on-line with Perit Marketplace: individuals could submit their own data or build RL missions, with Perit docking laboratories and split.

title: 印度 Sarvam AI 推出 Dictate 听写 API：自动去掉口误、重复和语气词，直接输出想写的文字，支持英语和 22 种印度语言
summary: Sarvam 发布面向开发者的听写接口 Sarvam Dictate：说话人常会重复、改口、用模型没见过的专有名词，Dictate 会同时返回原始转写和整理后的「想写的文本」，覆盖英语和 22 种印度语言，可传入词表、上下文和风格。单段音频最长 30 秒，价格每分钟 0.5 卢比，官方称准确率超过 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe。适合做输入法、笔记和客服场景的语音输入。

t.zh-Hans: 印度 Sarvam AI 推出 Dictate 听写 API：自动去掉口误、重复和语气词，直接输出想写的文字，支持英语和 22 种印度语言
t.en: Indian Sarvam AI rolls out Dictate Listening and Writing API: Automatically removes verbal errors, repetitions and words, directly outputs text that you want to write, supports English and 22 Indian languages

s.zh-Hans: Sarvam 发布面向开发者的听写接口 Sarvam Dictate：说话人常会重复、改口、用模型没见过的专有名词，Dictate 会同时返回原始转写和整理后的「想写的文本」，覆盖英语和 22 种印度语言，可传入词表、上下文和风格。单段音频最长 30 秒，价格每分钟 0.5 卢比，官方称准确率超过 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe。适合做输入法、笔记和客服场景的语音输入。
s.en: Sarvam releases a hearing interface for developers Sarvam Dictate: Talkers often repeat, rephrase, use proprietary terms that the model does not recognize, and Dictate returns both original transliterated and organized "texts that want to be written", covering English and 22 Indian languages, which can be passed on to vocabulary, context and style. One segment of the audio has a maximum of 30 seconds at a price of Rs. 0.5 per minute, which is officially stated to exceed Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. Sound input suitable for input methods, notes and guest scenes.

title: 两党议员痛批英伟达让黄仁勋回任：共和党议员称「品格失败」，特朗普对 CNBC 说是他亲自促成回归
summary: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋回任总裁兼 CEO 后（他 11 天前刚辞职），美国国会两党议员纷纷表达愤怒并要求调查。众议院网络与信息技术小组委员会主席、共和党人 Don Bacon 称「搞不懂为什么还要他回来，这是品格失败」，矛头指向商务部长卢特尼克；民主党参议员 Ron Wyden 说这证明「国家安全被卖给出价最高的人」。特朗普在 CNBC 专访中表示是他亲自说服董事会，「这笔交易是我谈成的」。英伟达芯片流入中国的问题仍是焦点。

t.zh-Hans: 两党议员痛批英伟达让黄仁勋回任：共和党议员称「品格失败」，特朗普对 CNBC 说是他亲自促成回归
t.en: The two-party congressmen are deeply concerned with the return of Young Weida to his post.

s.zh-Hans: 英伟达宣布黄仁勋回任总裁兼 CEO 后（他 11 天前刚辞职），美国国会两党议员纷纷表达愤怒并要求调查。众议院网络与信息技术小组委员会主席、共和党人 Don Bacon 称「搞不懂为什么还要他回来，这是品格失败」，矛头指向商务部长卢特尼克；民主党参议员 Ron Wyden 说这证明「国家安全被卖给出价最高的人」。特朗普在 CNBC 专访中表示是他亲自说服董事会，「这笔交易是我谈成的」。英伟达芯片流入中国的问题仍是焦点。
s.en: Following the announcement by In-hoon Wong (who resigned 11 days ago) that he had returned as CEO and CEO, two members of the United States Congress expressed anger and called for an investigation. Don Bacon, president of the Subcommittee on Networks and Information Technology of the House of Representatives, says, "It's a failure of character to understand why he needs to come back," and points to Minister of Commerce Lutnik; Democratic Senator Ron Wyden says, "National security is sold to the highest bidder." In an interview with CNBC, Trump said that he personally convinced the board that "I made the deal." The problem of the flow of British Weidar chips into China remains the focus.

title: 设计工具 Wonder 上线 Code Components：设计直接变成带属性、变体和状态的代码组件，人和 Agent 改一处、全站同步
summary: Wonder 是一个让人和 AI Agent 在同一画布上做设计和写代码的工具。11 月 23 日上线的 Code Components 可以把任意设计变成可复用组件，支持属性、变体、状态、替换和覆盖；不论是用户还是 Agent 修改，所有页面的实例都会跟着更新，也能把现有代码导入画布。这是 Figma Code Layers 之外，又一个把设计系统和代码绑在一起、给 Agent 用的方案。

t.zh-Hans: 设计工具 Wonder 上线 Code Components：设计直接变成带属性、变体和状态的代码组件，人和 Agent 改一处、全站同步
t.en: Design toolWonder Online Code Components: Design code components that directly transform into properties, variants and states, people and Agent to one full-stop sync

s.zh-Hans: Wonder 是一个让人和 AI Agent 在同一画布上做设计和写代码的工具。11 月 23 日上线的 Code Components 可以把任意设计变成可复用组件，支持属性、变体、状态、替换和覆盖；不论是用户还是 Agent 修改，所有页面的实例都会跟着更新，也能把现有代码导入画布。这是 Figma Code Layers 之外，又一个把设计系统和代码绑在一起、给 Agent 用的方案。
s.en: Wonder is a tool for people to design and write codes on the same canvas as AI Agent. Code Components, which are on line on November 23, can turn any design into a reusable component that supports attributes, variants, state, replacement and overwhelm; whether the user or Agent changes, all page examples will be updated and the existing code can be imported into the canvas. This is another program that binds design systems and codes to Agent, in addition to Figma Code Layers.

title: OpenAI 联手思科开源 Shirudo：让 AI Agent 实时写 eBPF 规则挡住漏洞利用，系统不停机、给打补丁争取时间
summary: 11 月 23 日 OpenAI 发布由 Cisco 与 OpenAI 共同打造的开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo。它让「守护型」Agent 监控系统，并动态编写 eBPF 控制规则拦截针对漏洞的攻击，无需停机，防守方可以有更多时间测试和上线正式补丁。这是 AI 安全从「找漏洞」走向「机器速度实时防守」的一步。

t.zh-Hans: OpenAI 联手思科开源 Shirudo：让 AI Agent 实时写 eBPF 规则挡住漏洞利用，系统不停机、给打补丁争取时间
t.en: OpenAI Joint Handicrafts open source Shirudo: allow AI Agent to write eBPF rules in real time to block the loophole, keep the system running and buy time for patches

s.zh-Hans: 11 月 23 日 OpenAI 发布由 Cisco 与 OpenAI 共同打造的开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo。它让「守护型」Agent 监控系统，并动态编写 eBPF 控制规则拦截针对漏洞的攻击，无需停机，防守方可以有更多时间测试和上线正式补丁。这是 AI 安全从「找漏洞」走向「机器速度实时防守」的一步。
s.en: On November 23, OpenAI launched the Open Source Linux Runtime Shirudo by Cisco and OpenAI. It allows the "demont" Agent surveillance system and dynamically develops eBPF control rules to intercept attacks against loopholes, without the need to stop, and the defensive party has more time to test and go online with formal patches. This is the first step of AI's security from “covering holes” to “real-time machine speed defense”.

title: Hoplite 获 Collison 兄弟领投 550 万美元并上线 Swarms：云端成千上万个 Agent 并行写代码
summary: 由利默里克大学辍学生 Ryan Morrissey 等创立的 Hoplite 宣布完成 550 万美元融资，Stripe 创始人 John 与 Patrick Collison 领投，Paul Graham、YC、Theo Browne、20VC 等参投，同时推出多 Agent 编程产品 Swarms。CEO 称未来是「云上成千上万个 Agent」，任何可验证的任务只受 token 和时间限制。

t.zh-Hans: Hoplite 获 Collison 兄弟领投 550 万美元并上线 Swarms：云端成千上万个 Agent 并行写代码
t.en: Hollite, led by Collison Brothers, $5.5 million and went online. Swarms: Thousands of Agents in the clouds.

s.zh-Hans: 由利默里克大学辍学生 Ryan Morrissey 等创立的 Hoplite 宣布完成 550 万美元融资，Stripe 创始人 John 与 Patrick Collison 领投，Paul Graham、YC、Theo Browne、20VC 等参投，同时推出多 Agent 编程产品 Swarms。CEO 称未来是「云上成千上万个 Agent」，任何可验证的任务只受 token 和时间限制。
s.en: The Hoplite, created by the University of Limerick, Ryan Morrissey and others, announced the completion of $5.5 million in financing, with the founders of Stripe, John and Patrick Collison, Paul Graham, YC, Theo Browne, and 20VC, among others, and the launch of multiple Agent programming products, Swams. The CEO describes the future as "tens of thousands of Agents on the clouds" and any verifiable tasks are subject to token and time limits.

title: SnyderBench：前沿模型设计的政治学研究方案，盲评中 93% 胜过哈佛顶级学者 Jim Snyder
summary: Free Systems 实验室发布新评测 SnyderBench：让 AI 生成社会科学研究问题和研究设计，再由博士专家与哈佛政治经济学家 Jim Snyder 的真实论文方案盲评对比。结果前沿模型（如 OpenAI Astra 6.2）在约 93% 的对决中胜出，而 GPT-4 时代远不及。说明 AI 在「模糊、靠判断」的科研设计上也在快速逼近甚至超过顶尖专家。

t.zh-Hans: SnyderBench：前沿模型设计的政治学研究方案，盲评中 93% 胜过哈佛顶级学者 Jim Snyder
t.en: SnyderBench: The political science research program on front-line model design, 93% of the blind reviews, outperformed the top Harvard scholar, Jim Snyder.

s.zh-Hans: Free Systems 实验室发布新评测 SnyderBench：让 AI 生成社会科学研究问题和研究设计，再由博士专家与哈佛政治经济学家 Jim Snyder 的真实论文方案盲评对比。结果前沿模型（如 OpenAI Astra 6.2）在约 93% 的对决中胜出，而 GPT-4 时代远不及。说明 AI 在「模糊、靠判断」的科研设计上也在快速逼近甚至超过顶尖专家。
s.en: Free Systems has released a new assessment, SnyderBench: let AI generate social science research issues and research designs, and be blindly compared by doctoral experts with the true paper programme of the Harvard political economist Jim Snyder. Outcome frontier models (e.g. OpenAI Astra 6.2) won about 93% of the match, while the GPT-4 era was far from over. This is an example of the fact that AI is also rapidly approaching and even surpassing top-notch experts in its "mixed, judgmental" scientific design.

t.en: A Swiss robot starts with CO: PROD and gets $6 million in pre-seed financing: standardized modules + unified software, making robots as fast as writing software.

s.en: The Swiss company CO: PROD ended its invisibility on November 23, announcing $6 million in pre-seed financing (one of the largest in Swiss history) to address the "integregated hell" being developed by robots: to provide standardized hardware components that open boxes to work with and to provide an easy-to-use unified software layer.

title: Stripe 数据：AI Agent 代购物复购率高——首单后 56% 用户会再下单，买满 9 次后升到 78%，沃尔玛拥抱 Agent、亚马逊却在封堵

t.zh-Hans: Stripe 数据：AI Agent 代购物复购率高——首单后 56% 用户会再下单，买满 9 次后升到 78%，沃尔玛拥抱 Agent、亚马逊却在封堵
t.en: Stripe Data: AI Agent has a high buy-back rate - 56% after the first order, users will re-order, buy nine times and then rise to 78%, and Wal-Mart hugs Agent and Amazon are blocked.

s.zh-Hans: Stripe 最新数据显示：10 月中前通过 AI Agent 完成首单的用户中，56% 回来下了第二单；累计 9 单后复购率升到 78%，且多在同一品类。沃尔玛积极对接购物 Agent，亚马逊则在屏蔽 Agent，形成对比。另有团队跑了 1.1 万多次 Agent 测试，研究 Agent 如何决定推荐哪些商品——「被 Agent 推荐」正在成为新的分发渠道。
s.en: The most Feature latest data show that 56 per cent of the users who completed the first order through AI Agent by mid-October returned to the second order; the cumulative repurchase rate rose to 78 per cent, mostly in the same category. Wal-Mart is actively shopping Agent, and Amazon is blocking Agent, in contrast. Another team ran away with more than 11,000 Agent tests to study how Agent is deciding which of the recommended commodities - "Recommended by Agent" - is becoming a new distribution channel.

t.en: USV Incubated Supertake receives $20 million seed wheel: in a big white word, AI helps you become a decentralized portfolio of coupons.

s.zh-Hans: Supertake 是 Union Square Ventures 孵化的投资产品：用户用自然语言写下自己对世界的看法（比如某个趋势会起来），AI 把它转成分散化的投资组合并连接券商账户下单，不懂投资也能「投自己的想法」。11 月 23 日宣布完成 2000 万美元种子轮（Adjacent 领投、USV 等参投），并请来前 Coinbase 的两位高管分任 CEO 和 CTO；上线约一个月，已有内测用户投入真金白银。
s.en: Supertake is an investment product of the Union Square Ventures: users write their views of the world in their natural language (e.g., a trend will rise), AI translates it into a fragmented portfolio and connects to the account of the voucher holder, without knowing how to "put their own ideas." On November 23, the completion of the $20 million seed ship (Adjacent, USV, etc.) was announced and two senior managers from Coinbase were invited to serve as CEOs and CTOs; for about a month on the line, internal survey users have been investing in real money and silver.

title: Anthropic 公开 Claude 发现的「VP ≠ VNP（对所有域）」证明：论文和 Lean 4 形式化全由 AI 完成，尚无人类数学家审核
summary: Anthropic 在 GitHub 的 formal-math 仓库放出 vp-vnp 文件夹：内部研究版 Claude 证明，对任意域，哈密顿圈多项式（以及特征非 2 时的积和式）的算术电路需要超多项式规模，因此代数复杂度里的 VP 严格小于 VNP，近似电路同样成立。论文和 Lean 4 证明都由 AI 写成，官方明确说这不解决 P vs NP，且没有人类数学家检查过证明，但 Lean 可复现编译并用第二个独立内核复核。登上 HN 首页数小时即 200+ 分、180+ 评论。

t.zh-Hans: Anthropic 公开 Claude 发现的「VP ≠ VNP（对所有域）」证明：论文和 Lean 4 形式化全由 AI 完成，尚无人类数学家审核
t.en: Anthropic Public Claude found proof of "VP OTHER VNP": Thesis and Lean 4 were completed by AI without human mathematicians Nuclear

s.zh-Hans: Anthropic 在 GitHub 的 formal-math 仓库放出 vp-vnp 文件夹：内部研究版 Claude 证明，对任意域，哈密顿圈多项式（以及特征非 2 时的积和式）的算术电路需要超多项式规模，因此代数复杂度里的 VP 严格小于 VNP，近似电路同样成立。论文和 Lean 4 证明都由 AI 写成，官方明确说这不解决 P vs NP，且没有人类数学家检查过证明，但 Lean 可复现编译并用第二个独立内核复核。登上 HN 首页数小时即 200+ 分、180+ 评论。
s.en: Anthropic released the vp-vnp folder from the form-math warehouse in GitHub: Internal study version Claude proved that the mathematical circuits of the Hamitton Circle (and the build-up-and-form of the characteristic non-two times) need to be oversized for any domain, so that VPs in algebra complexity are strictly smaller than VNPs and similar circuits are established. Both the paper and the Lean 4 certificate were written by AI, which the official authorities expressly stated did not resolve the Pvs NP and had not been examined by human mathematicians, but Lean could reproduce and use the second independent internal verification. On the HN first page, 200+min, 180+comments.

title: 开源邮件服务器 Stalwart 1.2 变身 Exchange 平替：实现 MAPI over HTTP、EWS、ActiveSync，Outlook 不用换就能连

The classics Outlook, Mac, Outlook, Apple and Mobile Mail App can be connected to it as even Exchange, and businesses can leave Exchange without changing their email client.
